                    float qTop = z.bottom + (j + 1) * step
                    float overlap = barOverlap(high, low, qTop, qBot)
                    if overlap > 0
                        hit := true
                        float overlapRatio = totalRange == 0 ? 0 : overlap / totalRange
                        float qDelta = barDelta * overlapRatio
                        z.deltas.set(j, z.deltas.get(j) + qDelta)
                        z.volumeTraded += vol * overlapRatio
                
                if hit and not z.wasHit
                    alert("Price testing Support SSL Zone at " + str.tostring(z.bottom), alert.freq_once_per_bar)
                    
                if low < z.bottom
                    z.swept := true
                    alert("Support SSL Zone Swept at " + str.tostring(z.bottom), alert.freq_once_per_bar)

                        int health = int(math.max(0, 100 - (z.volumeTraded / z.capacity * 100)))

                    else
                        z.decayLabel.set_x(na)
                else
                    z.decayLabel.delete()
                    
                z.wasHit := hit
                
                if hit or z.swept
                    z.evaluateReversals(false, high, low, close, open, barDelta, vol)
                    z.updateVisuals(false, showSwept, buyDeltaColor, sellDeltaColor, bslColor, sslColor)

// Process Active Trades
color barHighlight = na
if activeTrades.size() > 0
    for i = activeTrades.size() - 1 to 0
        if i < activeTrades.size()
            Trade t = activeTrades.get(i)
            if t.active
                if bar_index > t.entryBar // Wait until the next bar to start evaluating
                    bool inProfit = (t.dir == 1 and close > t.entry) or (t.dir == -1 and close < t.entry)
                    
                    if inProfit
                        t.consecBars += 1
                        if na(barHighlight) or barHighlight == color.yellow
                            barHighlight := color.aqua
                    else
                        t.consecBars := 0
                        if na(barHighlight)
                            barHighlight := color.yellow
                        
                    if t.consecBars >= dashboardHoldInput
                        t.active := false
                        t.won := true
                    else if bar_index - t.entryBar >= dashboardWindowInput
                        t.active := false // Time ran out
                    
                    if not t.active
                        if t.type == "ABS"
                            absTotal += 1
                            if t.won
                                absWins += 1
                        else if t.type == "EXH"
                            exhTotal += 1
                            if t.won
                                exhWins += 1
                        else if t.type == "DIV"
                            divTotal += 1
                            if t.won
                                divWins += 1
                        else if t.type == "REJ"
                            rejTotal += 1
                            if t.won
                                rejWins += 1
                        activeTrades.remove(i)

barcolor(dashboardHighlightInput ? barHighlight : na)

if barstate.islast
    if dashboardInput
        t_able.merge_cells(0, 0, 3, 0)
        cell(t_able, 0, 0, 'Reversal Performance (Time-Based)', txtColor = DATA, align = text.align_center)
        
        divider(t_able, 1, 3)
        
        cell(t_able, 0, 2, 'Signal', txtColor = HEADERS, align = text.align_left)
        cell(t_able, 1, 2, 'Total',  txtColor = HEADERS, align = text.align_right)
        cell(t_able, 2, 2, 'Wins',   txtColor = HEADERS, align = text.align_right)

        divider(t_able, 3, 3)
        
        float absRate = absTotal > 0 ? (absWins / absTotal) * 100 : 0
        cell(t_able, 0, 4, 'ABS', txtColor = DATA, align = text.align_left)
        cell(t_able, 1, 4, str.tostring(absTotal), txtColor = DATA, align = text.align_right)
        cell(t_able, 2, 4, str.tostring(absWins), txtColor = DATA, align = text.align_right)
        cell(t_able, 3, 4, str.tostring(absRate, '#.##') + '%', txtColor = absTotal > 0 ? (absRate >= 50 ? color.green : color.red) : DATA, align = text.align_right)
        
        divider(t_able, 5, 3)
        
        float exhRate = exhTotal > 0 ? (exhWins / exhTotal) * 100 : 0
        cell(t_able, 0, 6, 'EXH', txtColor = DATA, align = text.align_left)
        cell(t_able, 1, 6, str.tostring(exhTotal), txtColor = DATA, align = text.align_right)
        cell(t_able, 2, 6, str.tostring(exhWins), txtColor = DATA, align = text.align_right)
        cell(t_able, 3, 6, str.tostring(exhRate, '#.##') + '%', txtColor = exhTotal > 0 ? (exhRate >= 50 ? color.green : color.red) : DATA, align = text.align_right)
        
        divider(t_able, 7, 3)
        
        float divRate = divTotal > 0 ? (divWins / divTotal) * 100 : 0
        cell(t_able, 0, 8, 'DIV', txtColor = DATA, align = text.align_left)
        cell(t_able, 1, 8, str.tostring(divTotal), txtColor = DATA, align = text.align_right)
        cell(t_able, 2, 8, str.tostring(divWins), txtColor = DATA, align = text.align_right)
        cell(t_able, 3, 8, str.tostring(divRate, '#.##') + '%', txtColor = divTotal > 0 ? (divRate >= 50 ? color.green : color.red) : DATA, align = text.align_right)
        
        divider(t_able, 9, 3)
        
        float rejRate = rejTotal > 0 ? (rejWins / rejTotal) * 100 : 0
        cell(t_able, 0, 10, 'REJ', txtColor = DATA, align = text.align_left)
        cell(t_able, 1, 10, str.tostring(rejTotal), txtColor = DATA, align = text.align_right)
        cell(t_able, 2, 10, str.tostring(rejWins), txtColor = DATA, align = text.align_right)
        cell(t_able, 3, 10, str.tostring(rejRate, '#.##') + '%', txtColor = rejTotal > 0 ? (rejRate >= 50 ? color.green : color.red) : DATA, align = text.align_right)
    else
        t_able.clear(0, 0, 3, 10)

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------}

textSize(string s) =>
    switch s
        SIZE_TINY   => size.tiny
        SIZE_NORMAL => size.normal
        => size.small

    switch s
        POS_TL => position.top_left
        POS_BR => position.bottom_right
        POS_BL => position.bottom_left
        => position.top_right

inSession(string sess) => timeframe.isintraday and not na(time(timeframe.period, sess, tzInput))

// Pool map
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------{
float atr = ta.atr(14)

//untaken pools held in parallel arrays: price, side (1 buy-side above / -1 sell-side below), kind, tag, birth bar, drawings
var array<float>  pPrice = array.new<float>()
var array<int>    pSide  = array.new<int>()
var array<int>    pKind  = array.new<int>()
var array<string> pTag   = array.new<string>()
var array<int>    pBorn  = array.new<int>()
var array<line>   pLine  = array.new<line>()
var array<label>  pLbl   = array.new<label>()

// @function    retire pool i: its line ends at the given bar, its tag is removed
dropPool(int i, int endBar) =>
    line ln = pLine.get(i)
    ln.set_x2(endBar)
    label.delete(pLbl.get(i))
    pPrice.remove(i)
    pSide.remove(i)
    pKind.remove(i)
    pTag.remove(i)
    pBorn.remove(i)
    pLine.remove(i)
    pLbl.remove(i)

// @function    register a pool; a level printing within tolerance of an existing pool on the same side keeps only the more significant one
addPool(float price, int side, int kind, string tag, int startBar) =>
    bool keep = true
    int k = pPrice.size() - 1
    while k >= 0
        if pSide.get(k) == side and math.abs(pPrice.get(k) - price) <= eqTolInput * nz(atr)
            if pKind.get(k) >= kind
                keep := false
            else
                line.delete(pLine.get(k))
                dropPool(k, bar_index)
        k -= 1
    if keep
        pPrice.push(price)
        pSide.push(side)
        pKind.push(kind)
        pTag.push(tag)
        pBorn.push(bar_index)
        pLine.push(line.new(startBar, price, bar_index, price, color = color.new(poolColorInput, kind == KIND_DAY ? 0 : 30), style = kind <= KIND_EQ ? line.style_dotted : line.style_dashed, width = 1))
        pLbl.push(label.new(bar_index, price, tag, color = color(na), textcolor = poolColorInput, style = label.style_label_left, size = size.tiny))

// prior day levels
bool newDay = timeframe.change("D")
var float dayHi = na
var float dayLo = na
var int   dayStart = na
if newDay
    if showPdInput and not na(dayHi) and timeframe.isintraday
        // yesterday's untaken prior-day levels give way to the new ones
        int k = pPrice.size() - 1
        while k >= 0
            if pKind.get(k) == KIND_DAY
                line.delete(pLine.get(k))
                dropPool(k, bar_index)
            k -= 1
        addPool(dayHi, BULL, KIND_DAY, "PDH", bar_index)
        addPool(dayLo, BEAR, KIND_DAY, "PDL", bar_index)
    dayHi    := high
    dayLo    := low
    dayStart := bar_index
else
    dayHi := math.max(nz(dayHi, high), high)
    dayLo := math.min(nz(dayLo, low), low)

// Asian range and London session extremes, pooled when the window closes
trackSession(string sess, string name) =>
    var float sHi = na
    var float sLo = na
    var int   sStart = na
    bool inS = inSession(sess)
    if inS and not inS[1]
        sHi    := high
        sLo    := low
        sStart := bar_index
    else if inS
        sHi := math.max(sHi, high)
        sLo := math.min(sLo, low)
    if showSessInput and not inS and inS[1] and not na(sHi)
        addPool(sHi, BULL, KIND_SESSION, name + " H", sStart)
        addPool(sLo, BEAR, KIND_SESSION, name + " L", sStart)

trackSession(asiaSessInput, "Asia")
trackSession(londonSessInput, "London")

// equal highs and lows from swing points within tolerance of each other
float eqPh = ta.pivothigh(high, eqLenInput, eqLenInput)
float eqPl = ta.pivotlow(low, eqLenInput, eqLenInput)
var float lastEqPh    = na
var int   lastEqPhBar = na
var float lastEqPl    = na
var int   lastEqPlBar = na
float recentHi = ta.highest(high, eqLenInput)
float recentLo = ta.lowest(low, eqLenInput)
if not na(eqPh)
    if showEqInput and not na(lastEqPh) and math.abs(eqPh - lastEqPh) <= eqTolInput * atr and recentHi <= math.max(eqPh, lastEqPh)
        addPool(math.max(eqPh, lastEqPh), BULL, KIND_EQ, "EQH", lastEqPhBar)
    lastEqPh    := eqPh
    lastEqPhBar := bar_index - eqLenInput
if not na(eqPl)
    if showEqInput and not na(lastEqPl) and math.abs(eqPl - lastEqPl) <= eqTolInput * atr and recentLo >= math.min(eqPl, lastEqPl)
        addPool(math.min(eqPl, lastEqPl), BEAR, KIND_EQ, "EQL", lastEqPlBar)
    lastEqPl    := eqPl
    lastEqPlBar := bar_index - eqLenInput

// old highs and lows
float swPh = ta.pivothigh(high, swLenInput, swLenInput)
float swPl = ta.pivotlow(low, swLenInput, swLenInput)
float swRecentHi = ta.highest(high, swLenInput)
float swRecentLo = ta.lowest(low, swLenInput)
if showSwInput and not na(swPh) and swRecentHi <= swPh
    addPool(swPh, BULL, KIND_SWING, "SwH", bar_index - swLenInput)
if showSwInput and not na(swPl) and swRecentLo >= swPl
    addPool(swPl, BEAR, KIND_SWING, "SwL", bar_index - swLenInput)

// raids: the most significant pool traded through on this bar, per side
bool   kzOk      = not useKzInput or inSession(kzLondonInput) or inSession(kzNyInput)
bool   raidUp    = false   //buy-side pool raided (bearish setup)
bool   raidDn    = false   //sell-side pool raided (bullish setup)
string raidUpTag = ""
string raidDnTag = ""
int    raidUpKind = -1
int    raidDnKind = -1
int j = pPrice.size() - 1
while j >= 0
    float lvl  = pPrice.get(j)
    int   side = pSide.get(j)
    bool  hit  = side == BULL ? high > lvl : low < lvl
    bool  old  = pKind.get(j) <= KIND_EQ and bar_index - pBorn.get(j) > eqAgeInput
    if hit and pBorn.get(j) < bar_index
        if side == BULL and pKind.get(j) > raidUpKind
            raidUpKind := pKind.get(j)
            raidUpTag  := pTag.get(j)
        if side == BEAR and pKind.get(j) > raidDnKind
            raidDnKind := pKind.get(j)
            raidDnTag  := pTag.get(j)
        dropPool(j, bar_index)
    else if old
        line.delete(pLine.get(j))
        dropPool(j, bar_index)
    j -= 1
raidUp := raidUpKind >= 0 and kzOk
raidDn := raidDnKind >= 0 and kzOk

// live pools stay extended just past the last bar
if pPrice.size() > 0
    for k = 0 to pPrice.size() - 1
        pLine.get(k).set_x2(bar_index + 2)
        pLbl.get(k).set_xy(bar_index + 2, pPrice.get(k))

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------}
// Execution swings and displacement gaps
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------{
float sh = ta.pivothigh(high, mssLenInput, mssLenInput)
float sl = ta.pivotlow(low, mssLenInput, mssLenInput)
var float lastSh    = na
var int   lastShBar = na
var float lastSl    = na
var int   lastSlBar = na
if not na(sh)
    lastSh    := sh
    lastShBar := bar_index - mssLenInput
if not na(sl)
    lastSl    := sl
    lastSlBar := bar_index - mssLenInput

bool bullGapNow = bar_index > 2 and low > high[2] and (low - high[2]) >= gapMinInput * nz(atr)
bool bearGapNow = bar_index > 2 and high < low[2] and (low[2] - high) >= gapMinInput * nz(atr)

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------}
// Raid, shift, gap entry
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------{
var int    st       = S_IDLE
var int    dir      = 0
var string poolTag  = ""
var int    raidBar  = na
var float  ext      = na     //raided extreme, the invalidation
var int    extBar   = na
var float  mssLvl   = na
var int    mssFrom  = na
var int    mssBar   = na
var float  gTop     = na
var float  gBot     = na
var int    gLeft    = na
var int    gBar     = na
var float  entry    = na
var float  stop     = na
var float  target   = na
var string tgtTag   = ""
var int    fillBar  = na
var string lastResult = ""

var label  raidLbl  = na
var box    gapBox   = na
var box    tpBox    = na
var box    slBox    = na

bool evRaid   = false
bool evMss    = false
bool evFill   = false
bool evTarget = false
bool evStop   = false
bool evDayEnd = false

// @function    nearest opposing pool at least the minimum R away from the entry, else the fallback multiple
pickTarget(int d, float e, float s) =>
    float risk = math.abs(e - s)
    float best = na
    string tag = ""
    if pPrice.size() > 0
        for k = 0 to pPrice.size() - 1
            float lvl = pPrice.get(k)
            if pSide.get(k) == d and (d == BULL ? lvl > e : lvl < e) and math.abs(lvl - e) >= minRrInput * risk
                if na(best) or math.abs(lvl - e) < math.abs(best - e)
                    best := lvl
                    tag  := pTag.get(k)
    float dayExt = d == BULL ? dayHi : dayLo
    if not na(dayExt) and (d == BULL ? dayExt > e : dayExt < e) and math.abs(dayExt - e) >= minRrInput * risk
        if na(best) or math.abs(dayExt - e) < math.abs(best - e)
            best := dayExt
            tag  := d == BULL ? "Day high" : "Day low"
    if na(best)
        best := e + d * fallbackRInput * risk
        tag  := str.tostring(fallbackRInput) + "R"
    [best, tag]

closeTrade(string result, int endBar, float exitPrice) =>
    tpBox.set_right(endBar)
    slBox.set_right(endBar)
    color css = result == "Target" ? bullColorInput : result == "Stop" ? bearColorInput : GRAY
    label.new(endBar, exitPrice, result, color = color(na), textcolor = css, style = label.style_label_left, size = size.small)

// a fresh raid replaces any setup that has not been filled
bool takeRaid = st != S_TRADE and (raidUp or raidDn)
if takeRaid
    int d = raidDn ? BULL : BEAR
    // a bar raiding both sides is ambiguous: keep the side that closed back inside
    if raidUp and raidDn
        d := close > open ? BULL : BEAR
    float swing = d == BULL ? lastSh : lastSl
    if not na(swing)
        if st == S_ENTRY
            gapBox.delete()
        // a deeper raid on the same side, before any shift, supersedes the first one
        if st == S_RAID and d == dir
            raidLbl.delete()
        st      := S_RAID
        dir     := d
        poolTag := d == BULL ? raidDnTag : raidUpTag
        raidBar := bar_index
        ext     := d == BULL ? low : high
        extBar  := bar_index
        mssLvl  := swing
        mssFrom := d == BULL ? lastShBar : lastSlBar
        evRaid  := true
        raidLbl := label.new(bar_index, ext, "Raid " + poolTag, color = color(na), textcolor = d == BULL ? bullColorInput : bearColorInput, style = d == BULL ? label.style_label_up : label.style_label_down, size = size.small)

else if st == S_RAID
    // the raid may extend; the shift level follows the latest swing that formed before the extreme
    if dir == BULL and low < ext
        ext    := low
        extBar := bar_index
        raidLbl.set_xy(bar_index, low)
    if dir == BEAR and high > ext
        ext    := high
        extBar := bar_index
        raidLbl.set_xy(bar_index, high)
    if dir == BULL and not na(sh) and lastShBar < extBar
        mssLvl  := lastSh
        mssFrom := lastShBar
    if dir == BEAR and not na(sl) and lastSlBar < extBar
        mssLvl  := lastSl
        mssFrom := lastSlBar
    if bar_index - raidBar > mssWindowInput
        st := S_IDLE
        raidLbl.set_textcolor(color.new(GRAY, 30))
    else if dir == BULL ? close > mssLvl : close < mssLvl
        st     := S_GAP
        mssBar := bar_index
        evMss  := true
        line.new(mssFrom, mssLvl, bar_index, mssLvl, color = dir == BULL ? bullColorInput : bearColorInput, style = line.style_dashed, width = 1)
        label.new(int(math.round(0.5 * (mssFrom + bar_index))), mssLvl, "MSS", color = color(na), textcolor = dir == BULL ? bullColorInput : bearColorInput, style = dir == BULL ? label.style_label_down : label.style_label_up, size = size.small)

// displacement gap: the most recent gap of the shifting leg, formed after the extreme, at most two bars after the shift
if st == S_GAP
    bool gapHere = dir == BULL ? bullGapNow : bearGapNow
    if gapHere and bar_index - 2 >= extBar
        gTop  := dir == BULL ? low : low[2]
        gBot  := dir == BULL ? high[2] : high
        gLeft := bar_index - 2
        gBar  := bar_index
    bool gapValid = not na(gLeft) and gLeft >= extBar and gBar >= raidBar
    if gapValid and bar_index - mssBar >= 0 and gBar <= bar_index
        st     := S_ENTRY
        entry  := entryInput == ENTRY_CE ? math.avg(gTop, gBot) : dir == BULL ? gTop : gBot
        stop   := dir == BULL ? ext - stopBufInput * atr : ext + stopBufInput * atr
        [t, tg] = pickTarget(dir, entry, stop)
        target := t
        tgtTag := tg
        gapBox := box.new(gLeft, gTop, bar_index, gBot, border_color = color.new(gapColorInput, 40), bgcolor = color.new(gapColorInput, 75), text = "FVG", text_size = size.tiny, text_color = gapColorInput, text_halign = text.align_left)
    else if bar_index - mssBar >= 2
        st := S_IDLE

// track the gap from the shift leg while the shift is pending, so a gap printed with the shift candle counts
if st == S_RAID
    bool gapLeg = dir == BULL ? bullGapNow : bearGapNow
    if gapLeg and bar_index - 2 >= extBar
        gTop  := dir == BULL ? low : low[2]
        gBot  := dir == BULL ? high[2] : high
        gLeft := bar_index - 2
        gBar  := bar_index
    else if na(extBar) or (not na(gLeft) and gLeft < extBar)
        gLeft := na

// waiting for the retracement into the gap
if st == S_ENTRY and bar_index > gBar
    gapBox.set_right(bar_index)
    bool touched  = dir == BULL ? low <= entry : high >= entry
    bool stopped  = dir == BULL ? low <= stop : high >= stop
    bool missed   = dir == BULL ? high >= target : low <= target
    if touched
        st      := S_TRADE
        fillBar := bar_index
        evFill  := true
        tpBox := box.new(bar_index, dir == BULL ? target : entry, bar_index, dir == BULL ? entry : target, border_color = color(na), bgcolor = color.new(bullColorInput, 82), text = "TP " + tgtTag, text_size = size.tiny, text_color = color.new(bullColorInput, 0), text_halign = text.align_left)
        slBox := box.new(bar_index, dir == BULL ? entry : stop, bar_index, dir == BULL ? stop : entry, border_color = color(na), bgcolor = color.new(bearColorInput, 82), text = "SL", text_size = size.tiny, text_color = bearColorInput, text_halign = text.align_left)
        label.new(bar_index, dir == BULL ? low : high, "", color = dir == BULL ? bullColorInput : bearColorInput, style = dir == BULL ? label.style_triangleup : label.style_triangledown, size = size.small, tooltip = "Entry filled at " + str.tostring(entry, format.mintick))
        if stopped
            st         := S_IDLE
            evStop     := true
            lastResult := "Stop"
            closeTrade("Stop", bar_index, stop)
    else if stopped or missed or bar_index - gBar > entryWindowInput
        st := S_IDLE
        gapBox.set_bgcolor(color.new(gapColorInput, 90))
        gapBox.set_text(stopped ? "FVG · invalid" : missed ? "FVG · missed" : "FVG · expired")

// managing the open trade
else if st == S_TRADE and bar_index > fillBar
    bool hitStop   = dir == BULL ? low <= stop : high >= stop
    bool hitTarget = dir == BULL ? high >= target : low <= target
    if dayExitInput and newDay
        st         := S_IDLE
        evDayEnd   := true
        lastResult := "Day end"
        closeTrade("Day end", bar_index - 1, close[1])
    else if hitStop
        st         := S_IDLE
        evStop     := true
        lastResult := "Stop"
        closeTrade("Stop", bar_index, stop)
    else if hitTarget
        st         := S_IDLE
        evTarget   := true
        lastResult := "Target"
        closeTrade("Target", bar_index, target)
    else
        tpBox.set_right(bar_index)
        slBox.set_right(bar_index)

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------}
// Dashboard
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------{
var table dash = table.new(tablePos(dashPosInput), 2, 5, bgcolor = DASH_BG, border_width = 0, frame_color = DASH_FRAME, frame_width = 1)

if barstate.islast and showDashInput
    string sz = textSize(dashSizeInput)
    color dirCss = dir == BULL ? bullColorInput : bearColorInput
    string stTxt = switch st
        S_RAID  => (dir == BULL ? "Long" : "Short") + ": raid, wait for MSS"
        S_GAP   => (dir == BULL ? "Long" : "Short") + ": MSS, wait for gap"
        S_ENTRY => (dir == BULL ? "Long" : "Short") + ": wait for retrace"
        S_TRADE => (dir == BULL ? "Long" : "Short") + ": in trade"
        => "Scanning" + (lastResult != "" ? " (last: " + lastResult + ")" : "")
    bool hasPlan = st == S_ENTRY or st == S_TRADE or (st == S_IDLE and lastResult != "")
    float rr = hasPlan and math.abs(entry - stop) > 0 ? math.abs(target - entry) / math.abs(entry - stop) : na
    table.cell(dash, 0, 0, "Model 2022", text_color = DASH_TEXT, text_halign = text.align_left, text_size = sz)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 0, stTxt, text_color = st == S_IDLE ? DASH_TEXT : dirCss, text_halign = text.align_right, text_size = sz)
    table.cell(dash, 0, 1, "Pool Raided", text_color = DASH_HEADER, text_halign = text.align_left, text_size = sz)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 1, poolTag == "" ? "-" : poolTag, text_color = DASH_TEXT, text_halign = text.align_right, text_size = sz)
    table.cell(dash, 0, 2, "Entry / Stop", text_color = DASH_HEADER, text_halign = text.align_left, text_size = sz)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 2, hasPlan ? str.tostring(entry, format.mintick) + " / " + str.tostring(stop, format.mintick) : "-", text_color = DASH_TEXT, text_halign = text.align_right, text_size = sz)
    table.cell(dash, 0, 3, "Target", text_color = DASH_HEADER, text_halign = text.align_left, text_size = sz)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 3, hasPlan ? str.tostring(target, format.mintick) + " (" + tgtTag + ", " + str.tostring(rr, "#.#") + "R)" : "-", text_color = DASH_TEXT, text_halign = text.align_right, text_size = sz)
    table.cell(dash, 0, 4, "Killzone", text_color = DASH_HEADER, text_halign = text.align_left, text_size = sz)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 4, not useKzInput ? "Filter off" : (inSession(kzLondonInput) ? "London" : inSession(kzNyInput) ? "New York AM" : "Outside"), text_color = DASH_TEXT, text_halign = text.align_right, text_size = sz)

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------}
// Alerts
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------{
alertcondition(evRaid and dir == BULL,   "Sell-side Raid",      "Model 2022 on {{ticker}}: sell-side pool raided, waiting for a bullish market structure shift")
alertcondition(evRaid and dir == BEAR,   "Buy-side Raid",       "Model 2022 on {{ticker}}: buy-side pool raided, waiting for a bearish market structure shift")
alertcondition(st == S_ENTRY and st[1] != S_ENTRY, "Entry Gap Marked", "Model 2022 on {{ticker}}: structure shifted with displacement, entry gap marked")
alertcondition(evFill,                    "Entry Filled",        "Model 2022 on {{ticker}}: retracement into the gap filled the entry")
alertcondition(evTarget,                  "Target Reached",      "Model 2022 on {{ticker}}: target pool reached")
alertcondition(evStop,                    "Stop Hit",            "Model 2022 on {{ticker}}: price traded beyond the raided extreme")

=== FILE: luxalgo_nadaraya_watson_envelope.pine ===
// This work is licensed under a Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0) https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/
// © LuxAlgo

//@version=6
indicator("Nadaraya-Watson Envelope", "Nadaraya-Watson Envelope", overlay = true, max_lines_count = 500, max_labels_count = 500, max_bars_back=500)
//------------------------------------------------------------------------------
//Settings
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------{
h = input.float(8.,'Bandwidth', minval = 0)
mult = input.float(3., minval = 0)
src = input.source(close, 'Source')

repaint = input.bool(true, 'Repainting Smoothing', tooltip = 'Repainting is an effect where the indicators historical output is subject to change over time. Disabling repainting will cause the indicator to output the endpoints of the calculations')

//Style
upCss = input.color(color.teal, 'Colors', inline = 'inline1', group = 'Style')
dnCss = input.color(color.red, '', inline = 'inline1', group = 'Style')

//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------}
//Functions
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------{
//Gaussian window
gauss(x, h) => math.exp(-(math.pow(x, 2)/(h * h * 2)))

//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------}
//Append lines
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------{
n = bar_index

var ln = array.new_line(0) 

if barstate.isfirst and repaint
    for i = 0 to 499
        array.push(ln,line.new(na,na,na,na))

//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------}
//End point method
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------{
var coefs = array.new_float(0)
var den = 0.

if barstate.isfirst and not repaint
    for i = 0 to 499
        w = gauss(i, h)
        coefs.push(w)

    den := coefs.sum()

out = 0.
if not repaint
    for i = 0 to 499
        out += src[i] * coefs.get(i)
out /= den
mae = ta.sma(math.abs(src - out), 499) * mult

upper = out + mae
lower = out - mae
 
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------}
//Compute and display NWE
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------{
float y2 = na
float y1 = na

nwe = array.new<float>(0)
if barstate.islast and repaint
    sae = 0.
    //Compute and set NWE point 
    for i = 0 to math.min(499,n - 1)
        sum = 0.
        sumw = 0.
        //Compute weighted mean 
        for j = 0 to math.min(499,n - 1)
            w = gauss(i - j, h)
            sum += src[j] * w
            sumw += w

        y2 := sum / sumw
        sae += math.abs(src[i] - y2)
        nwe.push(y2)
    
    sae := sae / math.min(499,n - 1) * mult
    for i = 0 to math.min(499,n - 1)
        if i%2
            line.new(n-i+1, y1 + sae, n-i, nwe.get(i) + sae, color = upCss)
            line.new(n-i+1, y1 - sae, n-i, nwe.get(i) - sae, color = dnCss)
        
        if src[i] > nwe.get(i) + sae and src[i+1] < nwe.get(i) + sae
            label.new(n-i, src[i], '▼', color = color(na), style = label.style_label_down, textcolor = dnCss, textalign = text.align_center)
        if src[i] < nwe.get(i) - sae and src[i+1] > nwe.get(i) - sae
            label.new(n-i, src[i], '▲', color = color(na), style = label.style_label_up, textcolor = upCss, textalign = text.align_center)
        
        y1 := nwe.get(i)

//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------}
//Dashboard
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------{
var tb = table.new(position.top_right, 1, 1
  , bgcolor = #1e222d
  , border_color = #373a46
  , border_width = 1
  , frame_color = #373a46
  , frame_width = 1)

if repaint
    tb.cell(0, 0, 'Repainting Mode Enabled', text_color = color.white, text_size = size.small)

//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------}
//Plot
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------}
plot(repaint ? na : out + mae, 'Upper', upCss)
plot(repaint ? na : out - mae, 'Lower', dnCss)

//Crossing Arrows
plotshape(ta.crossunder(close, out - mae) ? low : na, "Crossunder", shape.labelup, location.absolute, color(na), 0 , text = '▲', textcolor = upCss, size = size.tiny)
plotshape(ta.crossover(close, out + mae) ? high : na, "Crossover", shape.labeldown, location.absolute, color(na), 0 , text = '▼', textcolor = dnCss, size = size.tiny)

//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------}

=== FILE: luxalgo_naked_poc.pine ===
// This work is licensed under a Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0) https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/
// © LuxAlgo

//@version=6
indicator("Naked POC"
  , shorttitle       = "Naked POC"
  , overlay          = true
  , max_lines_count  = 500
  , max_labels_count = 500)

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------}
// Constants
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------{
NPOC_COLOR     = #ff9800 // the untested level is the one highlight - the open magnet to watch
TESTED_COLOR   = #787b86 // tested levels are retired structure
LABEL_BG_COLOR = #00000000

DASH_BG   = #161616
DASH_TEXT = #DBDBDB

BASIS_VOLUME = "Volume"
BASIS_TPO    = "Time (TPO)"

STYLE_SOLID  = "Solid"
STYLE_DASHED = "Dashed"
STYLE_DOTTED = "Dotted"

SIZE_TINY  = "Tiny"
SIZE_SMALL = "Small"

STALE_TRANSPARENCY  = 80
TESTED_TRANSPARENCY = 40
MARKER_TRANSPARENCY = 30

DATE_FORMAT = "d MMM"

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------}
// Settings
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------{
PROFILE_GROUP = "Profile"
NPOC_GROUP    = "Naked POCs"
STYLE_GROUP   = "Style"

periodInput = input.timeframe("D", "Profile Period", group = PROFILE_GROUP
  , tooltip = "Timeframe of the sessions the profiles are built from. Each completed period builds its own profile, and the period's point of control is then tracked forward as a naked POC until price trades back through it. Keep the chart timeframe well below this period so every profile is built from enough bars.")

rowsInput = input.int(24, "Profile Rows", minval = 2, maxval = 100, group = PROFILE_GROUP
  , tooltip = "Number of equal price rows the period's range is split into when building its profile. More rows locate the point of control more precisely, while fewer rows smooth the profile when data is thin.")

basisInput = input.string(BASIS_VOLUME, "POC Basis", options = [BASIS_VOLUME, BASIS_TPO], group = PROFILE_GROUP
  , tooltip = "Weighting used to build each profile. 'Volume' marks the point of control at the row where the most volume traded, as in a volume profile; 'Time (TPO)' uses the row visited by the most bars, as in a TPO profile. Use Time (TPO) on symbols without volume data.")

maxNpocInput = input.int(50, "Maximum Naked POCs", minval = 1, maxval = 150, group = NPOC_GROUP
  , tooltip = "Most recent naked POC levels kept on the chart. Once the count is exceeded the oldest levels are removed first - recent naked POCs usually carry more weight than stale ones.")

npocColorInput = input.color(NPOC_COLOR, "Naked POC", inline = "npoc", group = STYLE_GROUP)

npocStyleInput = input.string(STYLE_SOLID, "", options = [STYLE_SOLID, STYLE_DASHED, STYLE_DOTTED], inline = "npoc", group = STYLE_GROUP
  , tooltip = "Color and line style of naked POC levels. Each level extends right from the close of the period that built it and keeps extending for as long as it remains untested.")

fadeInput = input.bool(true, "Fade With Age", inline = "fade", group = STYLE_GROUP)

fadeAfterInput = input.int(20, "", minval = 1, maxval = 500, inline = "fade", group = STYLE_GROUP
  , tooltip = "Fade naked POC levels as they age so fresher levels keep more visual weight. A level reaches its full fade once this many profile periods have completed since it was built.")

showLabelsInput = input.bool(true, "Date Labels", inline = "labels", group = STYLE_GROUP)

labelSizeInput = input.string(SIZE_TINY, "", options = [SIZE_TINY, SIZE_SMALL], inline = "labels", group = STYLE_GROUP
  , tooltip = "Tag each naked POC with the date of the period that built it, making recent levels easy to tell from stale ones. The dropdown sets the label size.")

showTestedInput = input.bool(false, "Show Tested POCs", inline = "tested", group = STYLE_GROUP)

testedColorInput = input.color(TESTED_COLOR, "", inline = "tested", group = STYLE_GROUP
  , tooltip = "Keep levels on the chart after price trades back through them, recolored, dashed and frozen at the testing bar. A tested POC is no longer naked and most traders retire it, though some keep it as an old reference.")

testMarkerInput = input.bool(false, "Test Markers", group = STYLE_GROUP
  , tooltip = "Draw a small marker on the bar that first trades back through a naked POC. The first return to the level is commonly watched for responsive trade, a bounce or a fade.")

//Option strings to drawing constants
npocLineStyle = switch npocStyleInput
    STYLE_DASHED => line.style_dashed
    STYLE_DOTTED => line.style_dotted
    => line.style_solid

npocLabelSize = labelSizeInput == SIZE_SMALL ? size.small : size.tiny

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------}
// Types & Variables
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------{
//One naked point of control being tracked for its first test
type Npoc
    line  levelLine
    label levelLabel
    float pocPrice
    int   bornPeriod

var array<Npoc> npocArray = array.new<Npoc>()

//Frozen drawings kept after a level is tested, capped so the most recent references stay visible
var array<line>  testedLineArray  = array.new<line>()
var array<label> testedLabelArray = array.new<label>()
var array<label> markerLabelArray = array.new<label>()

//Bars of the profile period currently building
var array<float> periodHighArray   = array.new_float()
var array<float> periodLowArray    = array.new_float()
var array<float> periodVolumeArray = array.new_float()

var int   periodStartTime  = na
var int   completedPeriods = 0
var float cumulativeVolume = 0.

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------}
// Functions
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------{
//Level color for a given age in completed periods, fading stale levels when enabled
agedColor(int age) =>
    fadeInput ? color.from_gradient(age, 0, fadeAfterInput, npocColorInput, color.new(npocColorInput, STALE_TRANSPARENCY)) : npocColorInput

//Point of control of the completed period: mid-price of the heaviest profile row, ties resolving toward the middle of the range
computePeriodPoc() =>
    float pocPrice = na
    int   barCount = periodHighArray.size()
    if barCount > 0
        float profileHigh = periodHighArray.max()
        float profileLow  = periodLowArray.min()
        float rowHeight   = (profileHigh - profileLow) / rowsInput
        if rowHeight > 0
            array<float> rowWeightArray = array.new_float(rowsInput, 0.)
            for i = 0 to barCount - 1
                float barHigh   = periodHighArray.get(i)
                float barLow    = periodLowArray.get(i)
                float barVolume = periodVolumeArray.get(i)
                float barRange  = barHigh - barLow
                int   firstRow  = math.max(0, math.min(rowsInput - 1, int(math.floor((barLow - profileLow) / rowHeight))))
                int   lastRow   = math.max(firstRow, math.min(rowsInput - 1, int(math.floor((barHigh - profileLow) / rowHeight))))
                for row = firstRow to lastRow
                    float rowBottom = profileLow + row * rowHeight
                    float rowTop    = rowBottom + rowHeight
                    float rowWeight = switch
                        basisInput == BASIS_TPO => 1.
                        barRange > 0            => barVolume * math.max(math.min(barHigh, rowTop) - math.max(barLow, rowBottom), 0.) / barRange
                        =>                         barVolume
                    rowWeightArray.set(row, rowWeightArray.get(row) + rowWeight)
            float bestWeight = 0.
            int   bestRow    = -1
            float middleRow  = (rowsInput - 1) / 2.
            for row = 0 to rowsInput - 1
                float rowWeight = rowWeightArray.get(row)
                if rowWeight > bestWeight or (bestRow >= 0 and rowWeight == bestWeight and math.abs(row - middleRow) < math.abs(bestRow - middleRow))
                    bestWeight := rowWeight
                    bestRow    := row
            if bestRow >= 0
                pocPrice := profileLow + (bestRow + 0.5) * rowHeight
        else
            //Flat period: every print sat on one price, which is its point of control by definition
            pocPrice := profileLow
    pocPrice

//Repaint level colors so fresher naked POCs keep more visual weight than stale ones
refreshLevelColors() =>
    int levelCount = npocArray.size()
    if levelCount > 0
        for i = 0 to levelCount - 1
            Npoc  level      = npocArray.get(i)
            color levelColor = agedColor(completedPeriods - level.bornPeriod)
            line.set_color(level.levelLine, levelColor)
            if not na(level.levelLabel)
                label.set_textcolor(level.levelLabel, levelColor)

//Register the completed period's POC as naked and start extending it to the right
createNpoc(float pocPrice, int builtTime) =>
    color levelColor = agedColor(0)
    line  levelLine  = line.new(bar_index - 1, pocPrice, bar_index, pocPrice, xloc.bar_index, extend.right, levelColor, npocLineStyle)
    label levelLabel = label(na)
    if showLabelsInput
        levelLabel := label.new(bar_index - 1, pocPrice, "NPOC " + str.format_time(builtTime, DATE_FORMAT, syminfo.timezone)
          , xloc.bar_index, yloc.price, LABEL_BG_COLOR, label.style_label_lower_left, levelColor, npocLabelSize)
    npocArray.push(Npoc.new(levelLine, levelLabel, pocPrice, completedPeriods))
    while npocArray.size() > maxNpocInput
        Npoc oldest = npocArray.shift()
        line.delete(oldest.levelLine)
        if not na(oldest.levelLabel)
            label.delete(oldest.levelLabel)

//Freeze a tested level at the testing bar, or remove it when tested levels are hidden
retireNpoc(Npoc level) =>
    if showTestedInput
        line.set_x2(level.levelLine, bar_index)
        line.set_extend(level.levelLine, extend.none)
        line.set_style(level.levelLine, line.style_dashed)
        line.set_color(level.levelLine, color.new(testedColorInput, TESTED_TRANSPARENCY))
        testedLineArray.push(level.levelLine)
        while testedLineArray.size() > maxNpocInput
            line.delete(testedLineArray.shift())
        if not na(level.levelLabel)
            label.set_textcolor(level.levelLabel, color.new(testedColorInput, TESTED_TRANSPARENCY))
            testedLabelArray.push(level.levelLabel)
            while testedLabelArray.size() > maxNpocInput
                label.delete(testedLabelArray.shift())
    else
        line.delete(level.levelLine)
        if not na(level.levelLabel)
            label.delete(level.levelLabel)
    if testMarkerInput
        markerLabelArray.push(label.new(bar_index, level.pocPrice, "", xloc.bar_index, yloc.price
          , color.new(testedColorInput, MARKER_TRANSPARENCY), label.style_circle, chart.fg_color, size.tiny))
        while markerLabelArray.size() > maxNpocInput
            label.delete(markerLabelArray.shift())

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------}
// Profile Construction & Naked POC Detection
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------{
bool newNpocEvent    = false
bool npocTestedEvent = false

bool newPeriod = timeframe.change(periodInput)

cumulativeVolume += nz(volume)

if na(periodStartTime)
    periodStartTime := time

//A completed period leaves its point of control behind as a naked POC
if newPeriod
    if periodHighArray.size() > 0
        completedPeriods += 1
        float pocPrice = computePeriodPoc()
        if not na(pocPrice)
            createNpoc(pocPrice, periodStartTime)
            newNpocEvent := true
        refreshLevelColors()
        periodHighArray.clear()
        periodLowArray.clear()
        periodVolumeArray.clear()
    periodStartTime := time

if not (na(high) or na(low))
    periodHighArray.push(high)
    periodLowArray.push(low)
    periodVolumeArray.push(nz(volume))

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------}
// Naked POC Tracking
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------{
//The first trade back through a level since its period closed tests it and removes its naked status
int levelIndex = 0
while levelIndex < npocArray.size()
    Npoc level = npocArray.get(levelIndex)
    if high >= level.pocPrice and low <= level.pocPrice
        npocTestedEvent := true
        retireNpoc(level)
        npocArray.remove(levelIndex)
    else
        levelIndex += 1

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------}
// Notices
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------{
var table noticeTable = table.new(position.top_right, 1, 1, border_width = 0)

string noticeText = switch
    timeframe.in_seconds() >= timeframe.in_seconds(periodInput) => "Chart timeframe must be lower than the profile period"
    basisInput == BASIS_VOLUME and cumulativeVolume == 0        => "No volume data - set POC Basis to Time (TPO)"
    => string(na)

if barstate.islast
    table.cell(noticeTable, 0, 0, na(noticeText) ? "" : noticeText
      , text_color = DASH_TEXT
      , text_size  = size.small
      , bgcolor    = na(noticeText) ? color(na) : DASH_BG)

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------}
// Alerts
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------{
alertcondition(newNpocEvent, "New Naked POC", "A profile period completed and left a new naked POC - its point of control starts untested. Open naked POCs above and below current price act as natural destinations when the market leaves balance.")
alertcondition(npocTestedEvent, "Naked POC Tested", "Price traded back through a naked POC for the first time since its period ended - the first touch is watched for responsive trade, a bounce or a fade, and the level is no longer naked.")

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------}

=== FILE: luxalgo_no_demand_no_supply_bars.pine ===

// © LuxAlgo

//@version=6
indicator("No-demand / No-supply Bars"
  , shorttitle       = "No-demand / No-supply Bars"
  , overlay          = true
  , max_labels_count = 500)
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------}
// Constants
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------{
MODE_TREND = "Moving Average Trend"
MODE_NONE  = "None"

TYPE_SMA = "SMA"
TYPE_EMA = "EMA"

SIZE_TINY   = "Tiny"

SIZE_NORMAL = "Normal"

color BULL_COLOR    = #089981

nsColorInput = input.color(BULL_COLOR, "No-Supply", inline = "colors", group = "Style",
  tooltip = "No-supply color - a down bar with nothing behind it: sellers failed to appear on the dip (bullish implication against background strength).")

ndColorInput = input.color(BEAR_COLOR, "No-Demand", inline = "colors", group = "Style",
  tooltip = "No-demand color - an up bar no professional money chased (bearish implication against background weakness).")

labelSizeInput = input.string(SIZE_TINY, "Tag Size", options = [SIZE_TINY, SIZE_SMALL, SIZE_NORMAL], group = "Style",
  tooltip = "Size of the ND and NS tags.")

showUnqualifiedInput = input.bool(false, "Ghost Unqualified Detections", group = "Style",
  tooltip = "Also tags detections printed against the wrong background, as faded ghost marks. VSA treats them as information, not signals - a low-volume dip inside a genuine downtrend is normal and proves nothing.")

showConfirmInput = input.bool(true, "Mark Next-Bar Confirmations", group = "Style",
  tooltip = "Marks the confirmation VSA commonly waits for before acting: an up close on the bar after a no-supply bar (the successful test), a down close on the bar after a no-demand bar. Triangles print on the confirming bar.")

showContextInput = input.bool(true, "Show Context Average", group = "Style",
  tooltip = "Plots the context average tinted by the background it reports - no-supply color while the close holds above it (strength), no-demand color below it (weakness). Hidden when the background filter is 'None'.")

colorBarsInput = input.bool(false, "Color Qualified Bars", group = "Style",
  tooltip = "Additionally paints the price bars that print a qualified detection.")

labelSize = labelSizeInput == SIZE_TINY ? size.tiny : labelSizeInput == SIZE_NORMAL ? size.normal : size.small

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------}
// Functions
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------{
//Tags a detection bar - qualified prints as a filled label, unqualified as a faded ghost tag
tagBar(bool isNoDemand, bool qualified, string bgText, float relSpread, float relVolume) =>
    color sideColor = isNoDemand ? ndColorInput : nsColorInput
    label.new(bar_index, isNoDemand ? high : low, isNoDemand ? "ND" : "NS"
      , style     = isNoDemand ? label.style_label_down : label.style_label_up
      , color     = qualified ? sideColor : LABEL_BG
      , textcolor = qualified ? chart.bg_color : color.new(sideColor, GHOST_TRANSPARENCY)
      , size      = labelSize
      , tooltip   = (isNoDemand ? "No-demand bar" : "No-supply bar")
      + (qualified ? "" : " - unqualified, background out of line")
      + "\n" + (isNoDemand ? "Up" : "Down") + " close on a narrow spread, volume below both prior bars"
      + "\nSpread: " + str.tostring(100 * relSpread, "#") + "% of average"
      + "\nVolume: " + str.tostring(100 * relVolume, "#") + "% of the lower prior-two print"
      + "\nBackground: " + bgText)

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------}
// Bar Detection
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------{
barSpread = high - low

//Rolling baselines, computed unconditionally on every bar
averageSpread = ta.sma(barSpread, spreadLengthInput)
contextSma    = ta.sma(close, contextLengthInput)
contextEma    = ta.ema(close, contextLengthInput)

contextAverage = contextTypeInput == TYPE_EMA ? contextEma : contextSma
useContext     = backgroundModeInput == MODE_TREND

//Classic VSA bar tests
upClose   = not na(close[1]) and close > close[1]
downClose = not na(close[1]) and close < close[1]

narrowSpread = not na(averageSpread) and barSpread < averageSpread * narrowSpreadInput

lowVolume = not na(volume) and not na(volume[2]) and volume < volume[1] and volume < volume[2]

//Bar classifications - settled on completed bars only, VSA reads the finished print
noDemand = barstate.isconfirmed and upClose and narrowSpread and lowVolume
noSupply = barstate.isconfirmed and downClose and narrowSpread and lowVolume

//Measured signature, reported in the tags and the data window
spreadRatio      = not na(averageSpread) and averageSpread > 0 ? barSpread / averageSpread : na
lowerPriorVolume = math.min(nz(volume[1]), nz(volume[2]))
volumeRatio      = lowerPriorVolume > 0 ? volume / lowerPriorVolume : na

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------}
// Background Grading & Confirmation
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------{
backgroundStrength = not na(contextAverage) and close > contextAverage
backgroundWeakness = not na(contextAverage) and close < contextAverage

//A bar means nothing on its own - no-supply is graded against background strength, no-demand against weakness
qualifiedNoDemand = noDemand and (not useContext or backgroundWeakness)
qualifiedNoSupply = noSupply and (not useContext or backgroundStrength)

//Next-bar close confirmation - back up after no-supply (the successful test), down after no-demand
noDemandConfirmed = bar_index > 0 and qualifiedNoDemand[1] and barstate.isconfirmed and downClose
noSupplyConfirmed = bar_index > 0 and qualifiedNoSupply[1] and barstate.isconfirmed and upClose

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------}
// Visuals
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------{
backgroundText = not useContext ? "filter off - every detection qualifies"
  : backgroundStrength ? "strength - close above the context average"
  : backgroundWeakness ? "weakness - close below the context average"
  : "undetermined"

if noDemand and (qualifiedNoDemand or showUnqualifiedInput)
    tagBar(true, qualifiedNoDemand, backgroundText, spreadRatio, volumeRatio)

if noSupply and (qualifiedNoSupply or showUnqualifiedInput)
    tagBar(false, qualifiedNoSupply, backgroundText, spreadRatio, volumeRatio)

//Context average, tinted by the background it reports
contextColor = backgroundStrength ? color.new(nsColorInput, CONTEXT_TRANSPARENCY)
  : backgroundWeakness ? color.new(ndColorInput, CONTEXT_TRANSPARENCY)
  : color.new(NEUTRAL_COLOR, CONTEXT_TRANSPARENCY)

plot(useContext and showContextInput ? contextAverage : na, "Context Average", contextColor, 1, plot.style_line)

//Next-bar confirmations on the confirming bar
plotshape(showConfirmInput and noDemandConfirmed, "No-Demand Confirmation", shape.triangledown, location.abovebar, ndColorInput, size = size.tiny)
plotshape(showConfirmInput and noSupplyConfirmed, "No-Supply Confirmation", shape.triangleup, location.belowbar, nsColorInput, size = size.tiny)

//Optional candle coloring; the measured signature is reported in the data window
barcolor(colorBarsInput and qualifiedNoDemand ? ndColorInput : colorBarsInput and qualifiedNoSupply ? nsColorInput : na, title = "Qualified No-demand / No-supply Bars")

plot(spreadRatio, "Spread / Average Spread", color = NEUTRAL_COLOR, display = display.data_window)
plot(volumeRatio, "Volume / Lower Prior-Two Volume", color = NEUTRAL_COLOR, display = display.data_window)

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------}
// Alerts
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------{
alertcondition(qualifiedNoDemand, "No-Demand Bar", "No-demand bar - up close on a narrow spread with volume below both prior bars; the rally lacks professional buying")
alertcondition(qualifiedNoSupply, "No-Supply Bar", "No-supply bar - down close on a narrow spread with volume below both prior bars; the dip lacks real selling")
alertcondition(noDemandConfirmed, "No-Demand Confirmed", "Down close on the bar following a no-demand bar - the weakness read is confirmed")
alertcondition(noSupplyConfirmed, "No-Supply Confirmed", "Up close on the bar following a no-supply bar - the test succeeded, sellers failed to appear on the dip")

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------}

//@version=6
indicator("Savitzky-Golay Filter", "S-G Filter", overlay = true, format = format.price, max_bars_back = 250, max_labels_count = 500, max_lines_count = 500, max_polylines_count = 100)

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------}
// Constants
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------{
BULL_COLOR    = #089981
BEAR_COLOR    = #f23645
ACCENT_COLOR  = #ff9800 // the one accent - the provisional edge of the fit, still forming
NEUTRAL_COLOR = #787b86

DASH_BG     = #161616
DASH_FRAME  = #2E2E2E
DASH_HEADER = #808080
DASH_TEXT   = #DBDBDB

MAX_DEGREE    = 6

MAX_SEGMENTS  = 95

SIDE_OFF  = "Off"

GRP_SIG   = "Slope Turns"
GRP_STYLE = "Style"

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------}
// Settings
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------{
srcInput = input.source(close, "Source", group = GRP_FIT
  , tooltip = "Series the polynomial is fitted to.")

halfWidthInput = input.int(15, "Half Width (m)", minval = 2, maxval = 100, group = GRP_FIT
  , tooltip = "The fit window holds 2m + 1 bars. Wider windows smooth more. The centered value for a bar is final only once the m bars after it have closed.")

degreeInput = input.int(2, "Polynomial Degree", minval = 1, maxval = MAX_DEGREE, group = GRP_FIT
  , tooltip = "Degree p of the least-squares polynomial fitted inside the window. Degree 1 makes the centered filter a simple moving average; degree 2 or 3 follows curvature, which is what lets the filter keep the height and timing of peaks and troughs instead of flattening them. Higher degrees track price more closely and pass more noise.")

  , tooltip = "Number of past bars the confirmed filter is drawn over.")

  , tooltip = "The last m bars have no centered value yet. The dotted edge shows the newest window's polynomial over those bars: it is provisional and is redrawn on every bar, while everything to its left is final. Its last point is the real-time filter value the signals use.")

markPeaksInput = input.bool(false, "Mark Confirmed Peaks / Troughs", group = GRP_FIT
  , tooltip = "Marks the highs and lows of the confirmed filter at the bar where they occurred, once known m + 1 bars later.")

sideInput = input.string(SIDE_LONG, "Signals", options = [SIDE_BOTH, SIDE_LONG, SIDE_OFF], group = GRP_SIG
  , tooltip = "Trades the slope of the real-time fit: the first derivative of the newest window's polynomial at the newest bar, a Savitzky-Golay derivative filter. A long opens when the slope turns positive and closes when it turns negative, shorts the reverse. Evaluated on closed bars, so a signal never moves once printed.")

minSlopeInput = input.float(0.05, "Minimum Slope (ATR per bar)", minval = 0, step = 0.01, group = GRP_SIG
  , tooltip = "A turn only counts once the fitted slope exceeds this fraction of the 14-bar ATR per bar, which skips the flat wobble of a sideways market. 0 trades every sign change.")

showTradesInput = input.bool(true, "Show Trades", group = GRP_SIG
  , tooltip = "Draws each entry, the line held while the position is open and the exit with the close-to-close change.")

lineWidthInput    = input.int(2, "Line Width", minval = 1, maxval = 4, group = GRP_STYLE)
bullColorInput    = input.color(BULL_COLOR, "Rising", inline = "c1", group = GRP_STYLE)
bearColorInput    = input.color(BEAR_COLOR, "Falling", inline = "c1", group = GRP_STYLE)
accentColorInput  = input.color(ACCENT_COLOR, "Provisional Edge", inline = "c2", group = GRP_STYLE)
neutralColorInput = input.color(NEUTRAL_COLOR, "Neutral", inline = "c2", group = GRP_STYLE)

showDashInput = input.bool(true, "Show Dashboard", group = GRP_DASH
  , tooltip = "Fit settings, slope and curvature from the polynomial's derivatives, and how much bar noise the centered and real-time fits pass compared with a simple moving average of the same window.")
dashPosInput  = input.string("Top Right", "Position", options = ["Top Right", "Top Left", "Bottom Right", "Bottom Left"], inline = "dash", group = GRP_DASH)
dashSizeInput = input.string("Small", "Size", options = ["Tiny", "Small", "Normal"], inline = "dash", group = GRP_DASH)

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------}
// Functions
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------{
// Least-squares projection for a polynomial of degree p over a window of n bars stored oldest first: the (p + 1) x n
// matrix (A'A)^-1 A' that turns the window into the polynomial's coefficients. Time is scaled to [-1, 0] (newest
// bar = 0) so the normal equations stay well conditioned. Stored row-major in a flat array.
sgProjection(int n, int p) =>
    int k = p + 1
    // augmented matrix [A'A | I]
    a = array.new_float(k * 2 * k, 0.0)
    for i = 0 to n - 1
        float t = (i - (n - 1)) / (n - 1.0)
        for j = 0 to k - 1
            for l = 0 to k - 1
                array.set(a, j * 2 * k + l, array.get(a, j * 2 * k + l) + math.pow(t, j + l))
    for j = 0 to k - 1
        array.set(a, j * 2 * k + k + j, 1.0)
    // Gauss-Jordan elimination with partial pivoting
    for c = 0 to k - 1
        int   piv  = c
        float best = math.abs(array.get(a, c * 2 * k + c))
        if c < k - 1
            for r = c + 1 to k - 1
                float v = math.abs(array.get(a, r * 2 * k + c))
                if v > best
                    best := v
                    piv  := r
        if piv != c
            for l = 0 to 2 * k - 1
                float tmp = array.get(a, c * 2 * k + l)
                array.set(a, c * 2 * k + l, array.get(a, piv * 2 * k + l))
                array.set(a, piv * 2 * k + l, tmp)
        float d = array.get(a, c * 2 * k + c)
        for l = 0 to 2 * k - 1
            array.set(a, c * 2 * k + l, array.get(a, c * 2 * k + l) / d)
        for r = 0 to k - 1
            if r != c
                float f = array.get(a, r * 2 * k + c)
                if f != 0
                    for l = 0 to 2 * k - 1
                        array.set(a, r * 2 * k + l, array.get(a, r * 2 * k + l) - f * array.get(a, c * 2 * k + l))
    // projection row j, column i = sum_l inverse[j][l] * t_i^l
    out = array.new_float(k * n, 0.0)
    for j = 0 to k - 1
        for i = 0 to n - 1
            float t = (i - (n - 1)) / (n - 1.0)
            float s = 0.0
            for l = 0 to k - 1
                s += array.get(a, j * 2 * k + k + l) * math.pow(t, l)
            array.set(out, j * n + i, s)
    out

// Polynomial coefficients of the least-squares fit to the last n values of a series
fitCoeffs(float src, array<float> proj, int n, int k) =>
    coef = array.new_float(k, 0.0)
    for i = 0 to n - 1
        float y = src[n - 1 - i]
        for j = 0 to k - 1
            array.set(coef, j, array.get(coef, j) + array.get(proj, j * n + i) * y)
    coef

// Value of the fitted polynomial at scaled time t (0 = newest bar, -1 = oldest bar of the window)
polyAt(array<float> coef, float t) =>
    float s = 0.0
    for j = 0 to array.size(coef) - 1
        s += array.get(coef, j) * math.pow(t, j)
    s

// Sum of squared convolution weights giving the fitted value at scaled time t0: the share of white-noise variance the
// filter passes (1 / n for a simple moving average of n bars)
noiseGain(array<float> proj, int n, int k, float t0) =>
    float g = 0.0
    for i = 0 to n - 1
        float s = 0.0
        for j = 0 to k - 1
            s += array.get(proj, j * n + i) * math.pow(t0, j)
        g += s * s
    g

getSize(string s) =>
    switch s
        "Tiny"   => size.tiny
        "Normal" => size.normal
        =>          size.small

getPosition(string p) =>
    switch p
        "Top Left"     => position.top_left
        "Bottom Right" => position.bottom_right
        "Bottom Left"  => position.bottom_left
        =>                position.top_right

fmtPct(float x) =>
    na(x) ? "-" : (x >= 0 ? "+" : "") + str.tostring(x, "0.00") + "%"

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------}
// Savitzky-Golay Fit
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------{
int   winLen = 2 * halfWidthInput + 1
int   degree = math.min(degreeInput, winLen - 2)
int   nCoef  = degree + 1
float scaleT = winLen - 1.0
float tMid   = -0.5

var array<float> proj        = sgProjection(winLen, degree)
var float        noiseEnd    = noiseGain(proj, winLen, nCoef, 0.0)
var float        noiseCenter = noiseGain(proj, winLen, nCoef, tMid)

bool ready = bar_index >= winLen - 1 and not na(srcInput[winLen - 1])

// One least-squares fit per bar over the last 2m + 1 bars. Evaluated at the window's middle it is the textbook
// centered Savitzky-Golay value of the bar m bars back, final now that the m bars after it have closed. Evaluated at
// the newest bar it is the real-time filter, with its slope and curvature, causal and final on the bar's close.
float sgReal   = na
float sgSlope  = na
float sgCurve  = na
float sgCenter = na
array<float> coef = array.new_float(0)
if ready
    coef     := fitCoeffs(srcInput, proj, winLen, nCoef)
    sgReal   := array.get(coef, 0)
    sgSlope  := nCoef > 1 ? array.get(coef, 1) / scaleT : 0.0
    sgCurve  := nCoef > 2 ? 2 * array.get(coef, 2) / (scaleT * scaleT) : 0.0
    sgCenter := polyAt(coef, tMid)

atr = ta.atr(14)
// label anchors clear of the neighbouring candles
float topAnchor = ta.highest(high, 5)
float botAnchor = ta.lowest(low, 5)

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------}
// Slope Turns
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------{
float thr = minSlopeInput * nz(atr)

var int slopeDir = 0
int prevDir = slopeDir
if not na(sgSlope)
    if sgSlope > thr
        slopeDir := 1
    else if sgSlope < -thr
        slopeDir := -1

bool turnUp   = slopeDir == 1 and prevDir != 1
bool turnDown = slopeDir == -1 and prevDir != -1

var int   position   = 0
var float entryPrice = na
var line  tradeLine  = na

bool  longEntry  = false
bool  shortEntry = false
bool  anyExit    = false
int   exitSide   = 0
float exitChange = na

if sideInput != SIDE_OFF and barstate.isconfirmed
    if (position == 1 and turnDown) or (position == -1 and turnUp)
        exitChange := position * (close - entryPrice) / entryPrice * 100
        exitSide   := position
        anyExit    := true
        if showTradesInput
            line.set_x2(tradeLine, bar_index)
            line.set_y2(tradeLine, close)
        position := 0
    longEntry  := position == 0 and turnUp
    shortEntry := position == 0 and turnDown and sideInput == SIDE_BOTH
    if longEntry or shortEntry
        position   := longEntry ? 1 : -1
        entryPrice := close
    if showTradesInput
        string exitText = anyExit ? "Exit " + fmtPct(exitChange) : ""
        string exitTip  = anyExit ? "The real-time slope turned against the " + (exitSide == 1 ? "long" : "short") + ". Close-to-close change from entry: " + fmtPct(exitChange) + ". " : ""
        if longEntry or shortEntry
            color c = longEntry ? bullColorInput : bearColorInput
            tradeLine := line.new(bar_index, close, bar_index, close, color = c, width = 2, style = line.style_dashed)
            string entryText = longEntry ? "S-G Long" : "S-G Short"
            string closedText = anyExit ? (exitSide == 1 ? "long " : "short ") + fmtPct(exitChange) : ""
            label.new(bar_index, longEntry ? botAnchor : topAnchor, anyExit ? (longEntry ? entryText + "\n" + closedText : closedText + "\n" + entryText) : entryText
              , style = longEntry ? label.style_label_up : label.style_label_down, color = c, textcolor = color.white, size = size.small
              , tooltip = exitTip + "The slope of the newest polynomial fit turned " + (longEntry ? "up" : "down") + " to " + str.tostring(sgSlope / atr, "0.00") + " ATR per bar.")
        else if anyExit
            label.new(bar_index, exitSide == 1 ? topAnchor : botAnchor, exitText
              , style = exitSide == 1 ? label.style_label_down : label.style_label_up, color = color.new(neutralColorInput, 20)
              , textcolor = DASH_TEXT, size = size.small, tooltip = exitTip)

if position != 0 and showTradesInput and not na(tradeLine)
    line.set_x2(tradeLine, bar_index)
    line.set_y2(tradeLine, close)

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------}
// Confirmed Filter & Provisional Edge
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------{
var array<float> centerHist = array.new_float()
var array<int>   centerBars = array.new_int()

if not na(sgCenter)
    array.push(centerHist, sgCenter)
    array.push(centerBars, bar_index - halfWidthInput)
    if array.size(centerHist) > historyInput
        array.shift(centerHist)
        array.shift(centerBars)

// Highs and lows of the confirmed filter, known once the next centered value is
bool peak   = not na(sgCenter[2]) and sgCenter[1] > sgCenter[2] and sgCenter[1] > sgCenter
bool trough = not na(sgCenter[2]) and sgCenter[1] < sgCenter[2] and sgCenter[1] < sgCenter

if markPeaksInput and (peak or trough)
    label.new(bar_index - halfWidthInput - 1, sgCenter[1], "●", style = label.style_none, textcolor = peak ? bearColorInput : bullColorInput, size = size.tiny
      , tooltip = (peak ? "Confirmed peak" : "Confirmed trough") + " of the centered filter, known " + str.tostring(halfWidthInput + 1) + " bars after it occurred.")

var array<polyline> segments = array.new<polyline>()
var polyline edgeLine = na

if barstate.islast
    for pl in segments
        polyline.delete(pl)
    array.clear(segments)
    polyline.delete(edgeLine)
    int n = array.size(centerHist)
    if n > 1
        // the confirmed filter, one polyline per rising or falling run, drawn from the newest run back
        int   runEnd = n - 1
        int   dir    = array.get(centerHist, n - 1) >= array.get(centerHist, n - 2) ? 1 : -1
        int   i      = n - 2
        while i >= 0 and array.size(segments) < MAX_SEGMENTS
            int d = i > 0 ? (array.get(centerHist, i) >= array.get(centerHist, i - 1) ? 1 : -1) : dir
            if d != dir or i == 0
                pts = array.new<chart.point>()
                for j = i to runEnd
                    pts.push(chart.point.from_index(array.get(centerBars, j), array.get(centerHist, j)))
                array.push(segments, polyline.new(pts, line_color = dir == 1 ? bullColorInput : bearColorInput, line_width = lineWidthInput))
                runEnd := i
                dir    := d
            i -= 1
    // the newest window's polynomial over the bars that have no centered value yet
    if showEdgeInput and array.size(coef) > 0
        pts = array.new<chart.point>()
        for k = 0 to halfWidthInput
            int b = bar_index - halfWidthInput + k
            pts.push(chart.point.from_index(b, polyAt(coef, (k - halfWidthInput) / scaleT)))
        edgeLine := polyline.new(pts, line_color = accentColorInput, line_width = lineWidthInput, line_style = line.style_dotted)

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------}
// Plots
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------{
plot(sgReal, "S-G Real-time", color.new(neutralColorInput, 0), display = display.data_window)
plot(sgSlope, "S-G Slope", color.new(neutralColorInput, 0), display = display.data_window)

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------}
// Dashboard
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------{
var table dash = table.new(getPosition(dashPosInput), 2, 5, bgcolor = DASH_BG, border_width = 0, frame_color = DASH_FRAME, frame_width = 1)

if barstate.islast and showDashInput
    ts = getSize(dashSizeInput)
    color slopeColor = slopeDir == 1 ? bullColorInput : slopeDir == -1 ? bearColorInput : neutralColorInput
    table.cell(dash, 0, 0, "S-G Fit", text_color = DASH_HEADER, text_halign = text.align_left, text_size = ts)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 0, str.tostring(winLen) + " bars, degree " + str.tostring(degree), text_color = DASH_TEXT, text_halign = text.align_right, text_size = ts)
    table.cell(dash, 0, 1, "Slope", text_color = DASH_HEADER, text_halign = text.align_left, text_size = ts
      , tooltip = "First derivative of the newest fit at the newest bar, in ATR per bar.")
    table.cell(dash, 1, 1, (sgSlope >= 0 ? "+" : "") + str.tostring(sgSlope / atr, "0.00") + " ATR/bar", text_color = slopeColor, text_halign = text.align_right, text_size = ts)
    table.cell(dash, 0, 2, "Curvature", text_color = DASH_HEADER, text_halign = text.align_left, text_size = ts
      , tooltip = "Second derivative of the newest fit (degree 2 or more). Slope and curvature with the same sign mean the move is accelerating.")
    table.cell(dash, 1, 2, degree < 2 ? "-" : sgCurve * sgSlope > 0 ? "Accelerating" : "Decelerating", text_color = DASH_TEXT, text_halign = text.align_right, text_size = ts)
    table.cell(dash, 0, 3, "Noise Passed", text_color = DASH_HEADER, text_halign = text.align_left, text_size = ts
      , tooltip = "Share of bar noise (standard deviation) passed by the centered fit and by the real-time fit, from their weights. A simple moving average of the same window passes " + str.tostring(math.sqrt(1.0 / winLen) * 100, "0") + "% and flattens peaks; the real-time fit passes more noise in exchange for no lag on polynomial trends.")
    table.cell(dash, 1, 3, str.tostring(math.sqrt(noiseCenter) * 100, "0") + "% / " + str.tostring(math.sqrt(noiseEnd) * 100, "0") + "% edge", text_color = DASH_TEXT, text_halign = text.align_right, text_size = ts)
    table.cell(dash, 0, 4, "Position", text_color = DASH_HEADER, text_halign = text.align_left, text_size = ts)
    string posText = position == 1 ? "Long " + fmtPct((close - entryPrice) / entryPrice * 100) : position == -1 ? "Short " + fmtPct((entryPrice - close) / entryPrice * 100) : "Flat"
    table.cell(dash, 1, 4, posText, text_color = position == 1 ? bullColorInput : position == -1 ? bearColorInput : DASH_HEADER, text_halign = text.align_right, text_size = ts)

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------}
// Alerts
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------{
