// This Pine Script® code is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public License 2.0 at https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/
// © Quant

//@version=6
indicator("Ultimate AMD Indicator", overlay = true, max_boxes_count = 500)

// --- Inputs ---
grp_amd = "AMD Settings"
accLen = input.int(50, "Accumulation Length", minval = 5, group = grp_amd)
accMaxRange = input.float(0.5, "Accumulation Max Range (%)", minval = 0.1, group = grp_amd, tooltip = "Maximum price range (in %) to be considered accumulation.")
brkType = input.string("Both", "Breakout Type", options = ["Wicks", "Bodies", "Both"], group = grp_amd)
maxManBars = input.int(20, "Max Manipulation Length (Bars)", minval = 1, group = grp_amd, tooltip = "If price does not reverse and break the opposite side of the accumulation range within this many bars, the manipulation is invalidated.")
maxAmd = input.int(5, "Max AMD Cycles Shown", minval = 1, group = grp_amd)

grp_fvg = "FVG Settings"
showFvg = input.bool(true, "Show FVGs", group = grp_fvg)
showIfvg = input.bool(false, "Show IFVGs", group = grp_fvg)
fvgMinAtr = input.float(0.5, "FVG Min ATR Multiplier", minval = 0.0, step = 0.1, group = grp_fvg)
maxFvgs = input.int(15, "Max Active FVGs/IFVGs", minval = 1, maxval = 100, group = grp_fvg)
filterOverlap = input.bool(true, "Filter Overlapping FVGs/IFVGs", group = grp_fvg, tooltip = "Prevents new FVGs or IFVGs from forming if they overlap with an existing active one of the same direction.")

grp_alerts = "Alert Settings"
alertAcc = input.bool(true, "Alert on Accumulation", group = grp_alerts)
alertMan = input.bool(true, "Alert on Manipulation", group = grp_alerts)

grp_colors = "Colors"
colorAcc = input.color(color.new(color.gray, 80), "Accumulation", group = grp_colors)
colorMan = input.color(color.new(color.yellow, 80), "Manipulation", group = grp_colors)
colorFvgBull = input.color(color.new(color.green, 80), "Bullish FVG", group = grp_colors)
colorFvgBear = input.color(color.new(color.red, 80), "Bearish FVG", group = grp_colors)
colorIfvgBull = input.color(color.new(color.green, 80), "Bullish IFVG", group = grp_colors)
colorIfvgBear = input.color(color.new(color.red, 80), "Bearish IFVG", group = grp_colors)
textColor = input.color(color.new(color.white, 50), "Box Text Color", group = grp_colors)
lblTextColor = input.color(color.white, "Label Text Color", group = grp_colors)

// --- State Variables ---
var int state = 0 // 0 = Searching Acc, 1 = Acc Active, 2 = Man Active, 3 = Dist Active
var float accTop = na
var float accBot = na
var int accStartBar = na

var float manTop = na
var float manBot = na
var int manStartBar = na

var int distStartBar = na
var int manDir = 0 // 1 for upward manip, -1 for downward

var box accBox = na
var box manBox = na
var label manLabel = na

var accBoxes = array.new<box>()
var manBoxes = array.new<box>()
var manLabels = array.new<label>()

// --- Helper Functions ---
get_high(type) =>
    switch type
        "Wicks" => high
        "Bodies" => math.max(open, close)
        => high

get_low(type) =>
    switch type
        "Wicks" => low
        "Bodies" => math.min(open, close)
        => low

// --- AMD Logic ---
h_val = get_high("Wicks")
l_val = get_low("Wicks")
brk_high = get_high(brkType)
brk_low = get_low(brkType)

highest_h = ta.highest(h_val, accLen)
lowest_l = ta.lowest(l_val, accLen)
range_pct = (highest_h - lowest_l) / lowest_l * 100

is_acc = range_pct <= accMaxRange

if state == 0
    if is_acc
        bool skipAcc = false
        if array.size(accBoxes) > 0
            box lastAcc = array.get(accBoxes, array.size(accBoxes) - 1)
            int proposedStart = bar_index - accLen + 1
            if proposedStart <= box.get_right(lastAcc)
                skipAcc := true
                
        if not skipAcc
            state := 1
            accTop := highest_h
            accBot := lowest_l
            accStartBar := bar_index - accLen + 1
            accBox := box.new(accStartBar, accTop, bar_index, accBot, border_color = color.new(colorAcc, 50), bgcolor = colorAcc)
            array.push(accBoxes, accBox)
            if alertAcc
                alert("AMD: Accumulation Phase Started", alert.freq_once_per_bar_close)
else if state == 1
    // Check if accumulation continues or breaks out
    if brk_high > accTop
        // Upward manipulation
        state := 2
        manDir := 1
        manStartBar := bar_index
        manTop := high
        manBot := accTop
        manBox := box.new(manStartBar, manTop, bar_index + 5, manBot, border_color = color.new(colorMan, 50), bgcolor = colorMan)
        manLabel := label.new(bar_index + 5, (manTop + manBot) / 2, "Manipulation", color = color.new(colorMan, 50), textcolor = lblTextColor, style = label.style_label_left, size = size.small)
        array.push(manBoxes, manBox)
        array.push(manLabels, manLabel)
        if alertMan
            alert("AMD: Bullish Manipulation Started", alert.freq_once_per_bar_close)
    else if brk_low < accBot
        // Downward manipulation
        state := 2
        manDir := -1
        manStartBar := bar_index
        manTop := accBot
        manBot := low
        manBox := box.new(manStartBar, manTop, bar_index + 5, manBot, border_color = color.new(colorMan, 50), bgcolor = colorMan)
        manLabel := label.new(bar_index + 5, (manTop + manBot) / 2, "Manipulation", color = color.new(colorMan, 50), textcolor = lblTextColor, style = label.style_label_left, size = size.small)
        array.push(manBoxes, manBox)
        array.push(manLabels, manLabel)
        if alertMan
            alert("AMD: Bearish Manipulation Started", alert.freq_once_per_bar_close)
    else
        // Accumulation continues
        accTop := math.max(accTop, highest_h)
        accBot := math.min(accBot, lowest_l)
        box.set_right(accBox, bar_index)
        box.set_top(accBox, accTop)
        box.set_bottom(accBox, accBot)

else if state == 2
    // Inside manipulation, looking for reversal to distribution
    box.set_right(manBox, bar_index + 5)
    label.set_x(manLabel, bar_index + 5)
    if manDir == 1
        manTop := math.max(manTop, high)
        box.set_top(manBox, manTop)
        label.set_y(manLabel, (manTop + manBot) / 2)
        if brk_low < accTop
            // Re-entered accumulation range -> Distribution Phase starts
            state := 3
            distStartBar := bar_index
    else
        manBot := math.min(manBot, low)
        box.set_bottom(manBox, manBot)
        label.set_y(manLabel, (manTop + manBot) / 2)
        if brk_high > accBot
            // Re-entered accumulation range -> Distribution Phase starts
            state := 3
            distStartBar := bar_index
            
    // Invalidate if manipulation takes too long without triggering distribution
    if state == 2 and bar_index - manStartBar > maxManBars
        state := 0
        box.delete(manBox)
        label.delete(manLabel)
        if array.size(manBoxes) > 0
            array.pop(manBoxes) // Remove the invalidated box from array
        if array.size(manLabels) > 0
            array.pop(manLabels) // Remove label from array

else if state == 3
    // Inside distribution
    // Reset condition to find new AMD cycle
    if bar_index - distStartBar > accLen
        state := 0

// Cleanup old AMD boxes
if array.size(accBoxes) > maxAmd
    bx = array.shift(accBoxes)
    box.delete(bx)
    
if array.size(manBoxes) > maxAmd
    bx = array.shift(manBoxes)
    box.delete(bx)
    lbl = array.shift(manLabels)
    label.delete(lbl)


// --- FVG Logic ---
atr = ta.atr(14)

type FVG
    box b
    bool isBull
    bool active
    float top
    float bot

var fvgArray = array.new<FVG>()

if showFvg or showIfvg
    // Detect FVG
    bullFvg = low > high[2] and (low - high[2]) > (atr * fvgMinAtr)
    bearFvg = high < low[2] and (low[2] - high) > (atr * fvgMinAtr)
    
    bool skipBull = false
    bool skipBear = false
    
    if filterOverlap and array.size(fvgArray) > 0
        for i = 0 to array.size(fvgArray) - 1
            f = array.get(fvgArray, i)
            if f.active
                if bullFvg and f.isBull
                    if low <= f.top and high[2] >= f.bot
                        skipBull := true
                if bearFvg and not f.isBull
                    if high >= f.bot and low[2] <= f.top
                        skipBear := true

    if bullFvg and not skipBull
        b = box.new(bar_index - 2, low, bar_index, high[2], border_color = showFvg ? color.new(colorFvgBull, 50) : na, bgcolor = showFvg ? colorFvgBull : na, text = showFvg ? "FVG" : "", text_color = textColor, text_halign = text.align_center, text_valign = text.align_center, text_size = size.small)
        array.push(fvgArray, FVG.new(b, true, true, low, high[2]))
        
    if bearFvg and not skipBear
        b = box.new(bar_index - 2, low[2], bar_index, high, border_color = showFvg ? color.new(colorFvgBear, 50) : na, bgcolor = showFvg ? colorFvgBear : na, text = showFvg ? "FVG" : "", text_color = textColor, text_halign = text.align_center, text_valign = text.align_center, text_size = size.small)
        array.push(fvgArray, FVG.new(b, false, true, low[2], high))
        
    // Manage array size
    if array.size(fvgArray) > maxFvgs
        removedFvg = array.shift(fvgArray)
        box.delete(removedFvg.b)
        
    // Update FVGs and check for invalidation (IFVG)
    if array.size(fvgArray) > 0
        for i = array.size(fvgArray) - 1 to 0
            f = array.get(fvgArray, i)
            if f.active
                box.set_right(f.b, bar_index + 5)
                
                // Check invalidation
                invalidated = false
                if f.isBull and close < f.bot
                    invalidated := true
                else if not f.isBull and close > f.top
                    invalidated := true
                    
                if invalidated
                    f.active := false
                    
                    bool skipIfvg = false
                    if filterOverlap
                        for j = 0 to array.size(fvgArray) - 1
                            if j != i
                                other = array.get(fvgArray, j)
                                if not other.active and other.isBull == f.isBull
                                    if f.bot <= other.top and f.top >= other.bot
                                        skipIfvg := true
                                        
                    if showIfvg and not skipIfvg
                        box.set_bgcolor(f.b, f.isBull ? colorIfvgBear : colorIfvgBull)
                        box.set_border_color(f.b, color.new(f.isBull ? colorIfvgBear : colorIfvgBull, 50))
                        box.set_text(f.b, "IFVG")
                    else
                        box.delete(f.b)
                        array.remove(fvgArray, i)
            else
                // It's an IFVG, keep extending if desired, or remove after some time
                if showIfvg
                    box.set_right(f.b, bar_index + 5)
                    
                    bool mitigated = false
                    if f.isBull and close > f.top
                        mitigated := true
                    else if not f.isBull and close < f.bot
                        mitigated := true
                        
                    if mitigated
                        box.delete(f.b)
                        array.remove(fvgArray, i)

=== FILE: luxalgo_valid_bos_pullback.pine ===
// This Pine Script® code is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public License 2.0 at https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/ MPL-2.0
//@version=6
indicator("Valid BOS Pullback", "Valid BOS Pullback", overlay = true, max_lines_count = 500, max_labels_count = 500)

// --- Inputs ---
leftBarsInput = input.int(3, "Swing left bars", minval = 1, group = "Structure", tooltip = "Number of preceding bars a structural swing must exceed.")
rightBarsInput = input.int(3, "Swing right bars", minval = 1, group = "Structure", tooltip = "Bars required to confirm a swing; the new high or low must be confirmed before a pullback can count.")
swingLookbackInput = input.int(48, "Structure lookback (bars)", minval = 6, maxval = 500, group = "Structure", tooltip = "Choose the highest confirmed previous high and lowest confirmed previous low within this window. 48 bars is 4 hours on a 5-minute chart.")
touchTicksInput = input.int(4, "Close invalidation tolerance (ticks)", minval = 0, group = "Structure", tooltip = "A close more than this far back through the old structure level invalidates the setup. A qualifying retest always requires the candle's actual high-low range to cross the exact line.")
minUntouchedBarsInput = input.int(5, "Minimum bars without a retest", minval = 0, maxval = 100, group = "Structure", tooltip = "After the initial break, require this many consecutive completed bars whose wicks do not touch the old level (at the exact line). An early touch resets the count; only a subsequent retest qualifies.")
minExtensionTicksInput = input.int(1, "Minimum initial break (ticks)", minval = 1, group = "Structure", tooltip = "Minimum closing distance beyond the old swing level to begin a setup.")
maxWaitInput = input.int(120, "Maximum setup age (bars)", minval = 5, maxval = 1000, group = "Structure", tooltip = "Discard unfinished setups after this many bars; confirmed historical setups remain visible.")
showDevelopingInput = input.bool(true, "Show developing levels", group = "Style", tooltip = "Show old swing and new extreme levels while waiting for a valid retest and final break.")
showPullbackTextInput = input.bool(true, "Show valid-pullback text", group = "Style", tooltip = "Show the pullback label as soon as an actual touch of the old structure line is confirmed.")
showTouchCircleInput = input.bool(true, "Mark retest touches", group = "Style", tooltip = "Draw a small circle on the old structure line at the candle that actually touched it.")
referenceColorInput = input.color(#EAEAEA, "Previous high / low", group = "Style", tooltip = "Color of the old structural swing that must be retested.")
bullColorInput = input.color(#7CFC00, "Bullish BOS / check", group = "Style", tooltip = "Color of bullish levels and confirmed annotations.")
bearColorInput = input.color(#f23645, "Bearish BOS / check", group = "Style", tooltip = "Color of bearish levels and confirmed annotations.")

// --- Setup data: each initial break runs independently, so newer breaks do not erase older ones ---
type BosSetup
    int direction
    int stage
    int startBar
    int referenceTime
    int extremeTime
    int retestTime
    float reference
    float target
    bool extremeConfirmed
    line referenceLine
    line targetLine
    label pullbackLabel = na
    label touchCircleLabel = na
    int cleanBars = 0
    int extremeBar = na

var array<BosSetup> activeSetupsArray = array.new<BosSetup>()
var array<float> highValuesArray = array.new<float>()
var array<int> highBarsArray = array.new<int>()
var array<int> highTimesArray = array.new<int>()
var array<float> lowValuesArray = array.new<float>()
var array<int> lowBarsArray = array.new<int>()
var array<int> lowTimesArray = array.new<int>()
// Confirmed BOS extremes are retired: the same swing can never become a new pullback reference.
var array<int> retiredHighTimesArray = array.new<int>()
var array<int> retiredLowTimesArray = array.new<int>()
var array<float> retiredHighLevelsArray = array.new<float>()
var array<float> retiredLowLevelsArray = array.new<float>()
var array<int> retiredHighBarsArray = array.new<int>()
var array<int> retiredLowBarsArray = array.new<int>()

float highPivot = ta.pivothigh(high, leftBarsInput, rightBarsInput)
float lowPivot = ta.pivotlow(low, leftBarsInput, rightBarsInput)
float touchAllowance = touchTicksInput * syminfo.mintick
float minExtension = minExtensionTicksInput * syminfo.mintick
bool bullBos = false
bool bearBos = false

if barstate.isconfirmed
    if not na(highPivot)
        array.push(highValuesArray, highPivot)
        array.push(highBarsArray, bar_index - rightBarsInput)
        array.push(highTimesArray, time[rightBarsInput])
    if not na(lowPivot)
        array.push(lowValuesArray, lowPivot)
        array.push(lowBarsArray, bar_index - rightBarsInput)
        array.push(lowTimesArray, time[rightBarsInput])
    while array.size(highBarsArray) > 0 and bar_index - array.get(highBarsArray, 0) > swingLookbackInput
        array.shift(highValuesArray)
        array.shift(highBarsArray)
        array.shift(highTimesArray)
    while array.size(lowBarsArray) > 0 and bar_index - array.get(lowBarsArray, 0) > swingLookbackInput
        array.shift(lowValuesArray)
        array.shift(lowBarsArray)
        array.shift(lowTimesArray)
    // Retire a completed level only while its original swing could still be in the structure window.
    while array.size(retiredHighBarsArray) > 0 and bar_index - array.get(retiredHighBarsArray, 0) > swingLookbackInput + rightBarsInput
        array.shift(retiredHighBarsArray)
        array.shift(retiredHighTimesArray)
        array.shift(retiredHighLevelsArray)
    while array.size(retiredLowBarsArray) > 0 and bar_index - array.get(retiredLowBarsArray, 0) > swingLookbackInput + rightBarsInput
        array.shift(retiredLowBarsArray)
        array.shift(retiredLowTimesArray)
        array.shift(retiredLowLevelsArray)

    // --- Advance EVERY candidate; preserve confirmed lines instead of deleting them ---
    int activeCount = array.size(activeSetupsArray)
    if activeCount > 0
        for step = 0 to activeCount - 1
            int index = activeCount - 1 - step
            BosSetup setup = array.get(activeSetupsArray, index)
            bool invalid = bar_index - setup.startBar > maxWaitInput
            bool completed = false
            if setup.direction == 1
                invalid := invalid or close < setup.reference - touchAllowance
                if not invalid
                    if setup.stage == 1
                        if na(setup.extremeBar)
                            setup.extremeBar := setup.startBar
                        if high > setup.target
                            setup.target := high
                            setup.extremeTime := time
                            setup.extremeBar := bar_index
                            setup.extremeConfirmed := false
                            if showDevelopingInput
                                line.set_x1(setup.targetLine, time)
                                line.set_y1(setup.targetLine, high)
                                line.set_y2(setup.targetLine, high)
                        // The new extreme is established once it survives the swing confirmation window.
                        if bar_index - setup.extremeBar >= rightBarsInput
                            setup.extremeConfirmed := true
                        bool touchedOldLevel = low <= setup.reference and high >= setup.reference
                        if touchedOldLevel and setup.extremeConfirmed and setup.cleanBars >= minUntouchedBarsInput
                            setup.stage := 2
                            setup.retestTime := time
                            if showPullbackTextInput
                                setup.pullbackLabel := label.new(setup.referenceTime, setup.reference, "Valid Pullback", xloc = xloc.bar_time, yloc = yloc.price, style = label.style_label_right, color = #00000000, textcolor = bullColorInput, size = size.small)
                            if showTouchCircleInput
                                setup.touchCircleLabel := label.new(time, setup.reference, "○", xloc = xloc.bar_time, yloc = yloc.price, style = label.style_circle, color = color.new(bullColorInput, 65), textcolor = bullColorInput, size = size.large)
                            if showDevelopingInput
                                line.set_x2(setup.referenceLine, time)
                                line.set_color(setup.referenceLine, bullColorInput)
                                line.set_style(setup.referenceLine, line.style_dashed)
                        setup.cleanBars := touchedOldLevel ? 0 : setup.cleanBars + 1
                    else if close > setup.target
                        completed := true
                        bullBos := true
            else
                invalid := invalid or close > setup.reference + touchAllowance
                if not invalid
                    if setup.stage == 1
                        if na(setup.extremeBar)
                            setup.extremeBar := setup.startBar
                        if low < setup.target
                            setup.target := low
                            setup.extremeTime := time
                            setup.extremeBar := bar_index
                            setup.extremeConfirmed := false
                            if showDevelopingInput
                                line.set_x1(setup.targetLine, time)
                                line.set_y1(setup.targetLine, low)
                                line.set_y2(setup.targetLine, low)
                        if bar_index - setup.extremeBar >= rightBarsInput
                            setup.extremeConfirmed := true
                        bool touchedOldLevel = high >= setup.reference and low <= setup.reference
                        if touchedOldLevel and setup.extremeConfirmed and setup.cleanBars >= minUntouchedBarsInput
                            setup.stage := 2
                            setup.retestTime := time
                            if showPullbackTextInput
                                setup.pullbackLabel := label.new(setup.referenceTime, setup.reference, "Valid Pullback", xloc = xloc.bar_time, yloc = yloc.price, style = label.style_label_right, color = #00000000, textcolor = bearColorInput, size = size.small)
                            if showTouchCircleInput
                                setup.touchCircleLabel := label.new(time, setup.reference, "○", xloc = xloc.bar_time, yloc = yloc.price, style = label.style_circle, color = color.new(bearColorInput, 65), textcolor = bearColorInput, size = size.large)
                            if showDevelopingInput
                                line.set_x2(setup.referenceLine, time)
                                line.set_color(setup.referenceLine, bearColorInput)
                                line.set_style(setup.referenceLine, line.style_dashed)
                        setup.cleanBars := touchedOldLevel ? 0 : setup.cleanBars + 1
                    else if close < setup.target
                        completed := true
                        bearBos := true
            if invalid
                if not na(setup.pullbackLabel)
                    label.delete(setup.pullbackLabel)
                if not na(setup.touchCircleLabel)
                    label.delete(setup.touchCircleLabel)
                if showDevelopingInput
                    line.delete(setup.referenceLine)
                    line.delete(setup.targetLine)
                array.remove(activeSetupsArray, index)
            else if completed
                color signalColor = setup.direction == 1 ? bullColorInput : bearColorInput
                if setup.direction == 1
                    array.push(retiredHighTimesArray, setup.extremeTime)
                    array.push(retiredHighLevelsArray, setup.target)
                    array.push(retiredHighBarsArray, bar_index)
                else
                    array.push(retiredLowTimesArray, setup.extremeTime)
                    array.push(retiredLowLevelsArray, setup.target)
                    array.push(retiredLowBarsArray, bar_index)
                if not showDevelopingInput
                    setup.referenceLine := line.new(setup.referenceTime, setup.reference, setup.retestTime, setup.reference, xloc = xloc.bar_time, color = signalColor, style = line.style_dashed, width = 2)
                    setup.targetLine := line.new(setup.extremeTime, setup.target, time, setup.target, xloc = xloc.bar_time, color = signalColor, width = 2)
                else
                    line.set_x2(setup.targetLine, time)
                    line.set_style(setup.targetLine, line.style_solid)
                label.new(setup.extremeTime, setup.target, "✓", xloc = xloc.bar_time, yloc = yloc.price, style = setup.direction == 1 ? label.style_label_down : label.style_label_up, color = signalColor, textcolor = chart.bg_color, size = size.small)
                // The pullback label was already drawn when the retest occurred; keep it with this completed setup.
                array.remove(activeSetupsArray, index)
            else
                if showDevelopingInput
                    if setup.stage == 1
                        line.set_x2(setup.referenceLine, time)
                    line.set_x2(setup.targetLine, time)
                array.set(activeSetupsArray, index, setup)

    // A level just confirmed as a BOS cannot remain the white reference of another live setup.
    int remainingCount = array.size(activeSetupsArray)
    if remainingCount > 0
        for step = 0 to remainingCount - 1
            int index = remainingCount - 1 - step
            BosSetup pending = array.get(activeSetupsArray, index)
            bool retiredReference = pending.direction == 1 ? array.includes(retiredHighLevelsArray, pending.reference) : array.includes(retiredLowLevelsArray, pending.reference)
            if retiredReference
                if not na(pending.pullbackLabel)
                    label.delete(pending.pullbackLabel)
                if not na(pending.touchCircleLabel)
                    label.delete(pending.touchCircleLabel)
                if showDevelopingInput
                    line.delete(pending.referenceLine)
                    line.delete(pending.targetLine)
                array.remove(activeSetupsArray, index)

    // --- Choose dominant confirmed swings for fresh initial breaks ---
    float previousHigh = na
    float previousLow = na
    int previousHighTime = na
    int previousLowTime = na
    if array.size(highValuesArray) > 0
        for index = 0 to array.size(highValuesArray) - 1
            float candidate = array.get(highValuesArray, index)
            int candidateTime = array.get(highTimesArray, index)
            if not array.includes(retiredHighTimesArray, candidateTime) and not array.includes(retiredHighLevelsArray, candidate) and (na(previousHigh) or candidate > previousHigh)
                previousHigh := candidate
                previousHighTime := candidateTime
    if array.size(lowValuesArray) > 0
        for index = 0 to array.size(lowValuesArray) - 1
            float candidate = array.get(lowValuesArray, index)
            int candidateTime = array.get(lowTimesArray, index)
            if not array.includes(retiredLowTimesArray, candidateTime) and not array.includes(retiredLowLevelsArray, candidate) and (na(previousLow) or candidate < previousLow)
                previousLow := candidate
                previousLowTime := candidateTime
    bool newBullSetup = not bullBos and not na(previousHigh) and time > previousHighTime and close > previousHigh + minExtension and close[1] <= previousHigh
    bool newBearSetup = not bearBos and not na(previousLow) and time > previousLowTime and close < previousLow - minExtension and close[1] >= previousLow
    // A prior setup's breakout level must not also become a new white reference line.
    if array.size(activeSetupsArray) > 0
        for index = 0 to array.size(activeSetupsArray) - 1
            BosSetup pending = array.get(activeSetupsArray, index)
            if pending.stage == 2 and pending.direction == 1 and not na(previousHigh) and math.abs(previousHigh - pending.target) <= syminfo.mintick
                newBullSetup := false
            if pending.stage == 2 and pending.direction == -1 and not na(previousLow) and math.abs(previousLow - pending.target) <= syminfo.mintick
                newBearSetup := false
    // A fresh structural break in the opposite direction cancels ALL unfinished setups
    // from the prior trend, including levels still waiting for their first retest.
    int pendingCount = array.size(activeSetupsArray)
    if (newBullSetup or newBearSetup) and pendingCount > 0
        for step = 0 to pendingCount - 1
            int index = pendingCount - 1 - step
            BosSetup pending = array.get(activeSetupsArray, index)
            if (newBullSetup and pending.direction == -1) or (newBearSetup and pending.direction == 1)
                if not na(pending.pullbackLabel)
                    label.delete(pending.pullbackLabel)
                if not na(pending.touchCircleLabel)
                    label.delete(pending.touchCircleLabel)
                if showDevelopingInput
                    line.delete(pending.referenceLine)
                    line.delete(pending.targetLine)
                array.remove(activeSetupsArray, index)
    if newBullSetup
        line refLine = showDevelopingInput ? line.new(previousHighTime, previousHigh, time, previousHigh, xloc = xloc.bar_time, color = referenceColorInput, width = 2) : na
        line highLine = showDevelopingInput ? line.new(time, high, time, high, xloc = xloc.bar_time, color = bullColorInput, width = 2) : na
        array.push(activeSetupsArray, BosSetup.new(1, 1, bar_index, previousHighTime, time, na, previousHigh, high, false, refLine, highLine))
    if newBearSetup
        line refLine = showDevelopingInput ? line.new(previousLowTime, previousLow, time, previousLow, xloc = xloc.bar_time, color = referenceColorInput, width = 2) : na
        line lowLine = showDevelopingInput ? line.new(time, low, time, low, xloc = xloc.bar_time, color = bearColorInput, width = 2) : na
        array.push(activeSetupsArray, BosSetup.new(-1, 1, bar_index, previousLowTime, time, na, previousLow, low, false, refLine, lowLine))

// --- Alerts: trigger on the close of the final break, never retroactively ---
alertcondition(bullBos, "Bullish retest-confirmed BOS", "Bullish BOS: old high retested, then the new high was broken on a confirmed close.")
alertcondition(bearBos, "Bearish retest-confirmed BOS", "Bearish BOS: old low retested, then the new low was broken on a confirmed close.")

=== FILE: luxalgo_weinstein_stage_analysis.pine ===

indicator("Weinstein Stage Analysis", shorttitle = "Weinstein Stage Analysis", overlay = true, max_labels_count = 500, max_lines_count = 500, max_boxes_count = 500)

// Stage identity hues: the two ranges (base, top) and the two trends (advance, decline)

color S2_COLOR      = #089981
color S3_COLOR      = #ff9800
color S4_COLOR      = #f23645
color NEUTRAL_COLOR = #787b86

color DASH_BG     = #161616
color DASH_FRAME  = #2E2E2E

// Settings

maWeeksInput = input.int(30, 'MA Length (weeks)', minval = 5, maxval = 100, group = GRP_MA, tooltip = 'Weinstein\'s 30-week moving average, the backbone of the method. The length is given in weeks and converted to chart bars: 30 bars on a weekly chart, 150 on a daily stock chart (5 sessions a week) and 210 on a 7-day market. The method is designed for weekly charts; daily charts give the same stages with earlier, noisier transitions.')

maTypeInput = input.string('SMA', 'MA Type', options = ['SMA', 'EMA', 'WMA'], group = GRP_MA, tooltip = 'Weinstein used a simple moving average. EMA and WMA react faster to turns.')

maColorInput = input.string('Stage', 'MA Color', options = ['Stage', 'Slope'], group = GRP_MA, tooltip = 'Color the MA by the current stage, or by its own slope (rising, flat, falling).')

slopeWeeksInput = input.int(4, 'Slope Lookback (weeks)', minval = 1, maxval = 26, group = GRP_MA, tooltip = 'The MA slope is its percentage change over this many weeks. The stage machine reads the slope as rising, flat or falling.')

flatBandInput = input.float(1.0, 'Flat Band %', minval = 0.1, maxval = 10, step = 0.1, group = GRP_MA, tooltip = 'A change inside plus or minus this percentage over the slope lookback reads as a flat MA, the signature of Stage 1 bases and Stage 3 tops. Above it the MA is rising, below it falling.')

minBaseWeeksInput = input.int(4, 'Minimum Base (weeks)', minval = 1, maxval = 52, group = GRP_STAGE, tooltip = 'A Stage 1 base must last at least this long before a breakout above its resistance counts as Stage 2. Bases that are too short have not absorbed the supply left by the decline.')

rangeWeeksInput = input.int(10, 'Range Lookback (weeks)', minval = 2, maxval = 52, group = GRP_STAGE, tooltip = 'When Stage 1 begins, the base is anchored on the lowest low of this many prior weeks (the decline low) and spans every high since; when Stage 3 begins, the top is anchored on the highest high (the Stage 2 peak) and spans every low since. The range then widens with every bar until price closes outside it: above resistance for Stage 2, below support for Stage 4.')

slopeFilterInput = input.bool(true, 'MA Must Not Oppose the Break', group = GRP_STAGE, tooltip = 'Weinstein\'s core filter: a Stage 2 breakout is only accepted while the MA is not falling, and a Stage 4 breakdown only while it is not rising. Never buy below a declining 30-week MA, never short above a rising one.')

volWeeksInput = input.int(4, 'Volume Average (weeks)', minval = 1, maxval = 52, group = GRP_STAGE, tooltip = 'Breakout volume is compared with the average volume of this many prior weeks.')

volMultInput = input.float(2.0, 'Breakout Volume (x average)', minval = 1.0, maxval = 10, step = 0.1, group = GRP_STAGE, tooltip = 'Weinstein wants a Stage 2 breakout on volume at least twice the recent average. Every breakout reports its volume ratio; breakouts below this multiple are graded light.')

volFilterInput = input.bool(false, 'Require Breakout Volume', group = GRP_STAGE, tooltip = 'Reject Stage 2 breakouts traded below the volume multiple instead of only grading them. Breakdowns are never volume filtered: Weinstein notes a stock can fall of its own weight. Ignored on symbols without volume.')

benchInput = input.symbol('SP:SPX', 'Benchmark', group = GRP_RS, tooltip = 'Market index the chart symbol is measured against for the Mansfield Relative Strength line.')

rsWeeksInput = input.int(52, 'Mansfield RS Length (weeks)', minval = 4, maxval = 104, group = GRP_RS, tooltip = 'Mansfield RS = (price / benchmark) divided by its own moving average over this many weeks, minus 1, in percent. Above zero the symbol is outperforming its usual relationship to the market, below zero it is lagging.')

rsFilterInput = input.bool(false, 'Require Positive RS for Stage 2', group = GRP_RS, tooltip = 'Only accept Stage 2 breakouts while Mansfield RS is above zero, the way Weinstein screened for leaders. Ignored when the benchmark cannot be loaded.')

retestInput = input.bool(true, 'Mark Retests of the Break Level', group = GRP_STAGE, tooltip = 'Weinstein\'s second entry: after a Stage 2 breakout, the first pullback that tests the old resistance and closes back above it; after a Stage 4 breakdown, the first rally that tests the old support and closes back below it.')

retestWeeksInput = input.int(8, 'Retest Window (weeks)', minval = 1, maxval = 52, group = GRP_STAGE, tooltip = 'How long after the break a retest is still marked.')

retestTolInput = input.float(2.0, 'Retest Tolerance %', minval = 0, maxval = 10, step = 0.25, group = GRP_STAGE, tooltip = 'How close to the break level a pullback must come to count as a test.')

tradeInput = input.string('Long & Short', 'Trades', options = ['Long & Short', 'Long Only', 'Off'], group = GRP_TRADE, tooltip = 'Long entries on Stage 2 breakouts, short entries on Stage 4 breakdowns, each with a protective stop managed the way Weinstein describes.')

stopWeeksInput = input.int(4, 'Initial Stop Lookback (weeks)', minval = 1, maxval = 26, group = GRP_TRADE, tooltip = 'The initial stop sits just beyond the most recent correction extreme: the lowest low of this many weeks before a long breakout, the highest high before a short breakdown.')

trailInput = input.bool(true, 'Trail Behind Corrections', group = GRP_TRADE, tooltip = 'Raise a long stop to just below each confirmed correction low once the advance makes a new high above the peak that preceded it (mirror for shorts), and tighten it to the range edge when the next range stage begins: Stage 3 for longs, Stage 1 for shorts. Waiting for the new extreme keeps the stop under real corrections, not every pause.')

swingWeeksInput = input.int(1, 'Correction Swing Length (weeks)', minval = 1, maxval = 8, group = GRP_TRADE, tooltip = 'Bars on each side a low (high) must dominate to count as a correction extreme for the trailing stop, in weeks. A swing is known only this long after it prints.')

bufferInput = input.float(0.5, 'Stop Buffer %', minval = 0, maxval = 10, step = 0.1, group = GRP_TRADE, tooltip = 'Distance placed beyond each stop reference so the stop does not sit exactly on a round low or high.')

showDashInput = input.bool(true, 'Show Dashboard', group = GRP_DASH)
dashPosInput  = input.string('Bottom Right', 'Position', options = ['Top Right', 'Top Left', 'Bottom Right', 'Bottom Left'], inline = 'dash', group = GRP_DASH)
dashSizeInput = input.string('Small', 'Size', options = ['Tiny', 'Small', 'Normal'], inline = 'dash', group = GRP_DASH)

showBoxesInput  = input.bool(true, 'Range Boxes', group = GRP_STYLE, tooltip = 'Box each Stage 1 base and Stage 3 top from its seed to the bar that resolves it.')
showLabelsInput = input.bool(true, 'Stage Labels', group = GRP_STYLE)
showBgInput     = input.bool(false, 'Stage Background', group = GRP_STYLE, tooltip = 'Faint background tint in the current stage color.')
bgTranspInput   = input.int(94, 'Background Transparency', minval = 80, maxval = 100, group = GRP_STYLE)
s1ColorInput    = input.color(S1_COLOR, 'Stage 1', inline = 'c1', group = GRP_STYLE)
s2ColorInput    = input.color(S2_COLOR, 'Stage 2', inline = 'c1', group = GRP_STYLE)
s3ColorInput    = input.color(S3_COLOR, 'Stage 3', inline = 'c2', group = GRP_STYLE)
s4ColorInput    = input.color(S4_COLOR, 'Stage 4', inline = 'c2', group = GRP_STYLE)

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------}
// Functions
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------{

stageColor(int s) =>
    switch s
        1 => s1ColorInput
        2 => s2ColorInput
        3 => s3ColorInput
        4 => s4ColorInput
        => NEUTRAL_COLOR

stageName(int s) =>
    switch s
        1 => 'Stage 1 · Basing'
        2 => 'Stage 2 · Advancing'
        3 => 'Stage 3 · Topping'
        4 => 'Stage 4 · Declining'
        => 'Undetermined'

fmtPrice(float v) =>
    na(v) ? '-' : str.tostring(v, format.mintick)

fmtSigned(float v, string fmt) =>
    na(v) ? 'n/a' : (v >= 0 ? '+' : '') + str.tostring(v, fmt)

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------}
// Calculations
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------{

// Bars per week on the chart timeframe: weekly 1, daily 5 (7 on 7-day markets), intraday from the session length
bool  sevenDay    = syminfo.type == 'crypto'
float barsPerWeek = timeframe.isweekly ? 1.0 / timeframe.multiplier : timeframe.ismonthly ? 1.0 / (4.345 * timeframe.multiplier) : timeframe.isdaily ? (sevenDay ? 7.0 : 5.0) / timeframe.multiplier : (sevenDay ? 7.0 * 1440 : 5.0 * 390) / math.max(1.0, timeframe.in_seconds(timeframe.period) / 60.0)

int maLen    = math.max(2, math.round(maWeeksInput * barsPerWeek))
int slopeLen = math.max(1, math.round(slopeWeeksInput * barsPerWeek))
int baseLen  = math.max(1, math.round(minBaseWeeksInput * barsPerWeek))
int rangeLen = math.max(2, math.round(rangeWeeksInput * barsPerWeek))
int volLen   = math.max(1, math.round(volWeeksInput * barsPerWeek))
int rsLen    = math.max(2, math.round(rsWeeksInput * barsPerWeek))
int stopLen  = math.max(1, math.round(stopWeeksInput * barsPerWeek))
int swingLen = math.max(2, math.round(swingWeeksInput * barsPerWeek))
int retestLen = math.max(1, math.round(retestWeeksInput * barsPerWeek))

float maSma = ta.sma(close, maLen)
float maEma = ta.ema(close, maLen)
float maWma = ta.wma(close, maLen)
float ma    = maTypeInput == 'EMA' ? maEma : maTypeInput == 'WMA' ? maWma : maSma

float slopePct   = ma[slopeLen] > 0 ? (ma / ma[slopeLen] - 1) * 100 : na
int   slopeState = na(slopePct) ? 0 : slopePct > flatBandInput ? 1 : slopePct < -flatBandInput ? -1 : 0

// Mansfield relative strength against the benchmark (na when the benchmark cannot be loaded)
float benchClose = request.security(benchInput, timeframe.period, close, ignore_invalid_symbol = true)
float rsRatio    = benchClose > 0 ? close / benchClose : na
float rsRatioMa  = ta.sma(rsRatio, rsLen)
float mansfield  = rsRatioMa > 0 ? (rsRatio / rsRatioMa - 1) * 100 : na
bool  rsKnown    = not na(mansfield)

// Volume against the average of the prior weeks
float volAvg   = ta.sma(nz(volume), volLen)[1]
float volRatio = volAvg > 0 ? nz(volume) / volAvg : na

// per-bar history indexed by bar_index, read when a range is seeded
var array<float> highArr = array.new<float>()
var array<float> lowArr  = array.new<float>()
array.push(highArr, high)
array.push(lowArr, low)

float atrVal   = ta.atr(14)
float stopLow  = ta.lowest(low, stopLen)
float stopHigh = ta.highest(high, stopLen)
float pivLow   = ta.pivotlow(low, swingLen, swingLen)
float pivHigh  = ta.pivothigh(high, swingLen, swingLen)

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------}
// Stage Machine
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------{

var int   stage      = 0
var int   stageStart = na
var float rangeTop   = na
var float rangeBot   = na
var int   rangeLeft  = na
var box   rangeBox   = na
var float lastBreakVol = na
var float breakLevel   = na
var bool  retested     = true

// trade state: 1 long, -1 short
var int   pos      = 0
var float stopLvl  = na
var float entryPx  = na
var int   entryBar = na
var float tradeExt = na // best extreme since entry: highest high long, lowest low short
var float candStop = na // pending correction extreme, promoted once the trend makes a new extreme
var float candRef  = na

bool toS1 = false
bool toS2 = false
bool toS3 = false
bool toS4 = false
bool longEntry  = false
bool shortEntry = false
bool retestUp   = false
bool retestDown = false
bool longExit   = false
bool shortExit  = false
string exitWhy  = ''
bool initial    = false

bool ready  = not na(ma) and not na(slopePct) and barstate.isconfirmed
bool volOk  = not volFilterInput or na(volRatio) or nz(volume) == 0 or volRatio >= volMultInput
bool rsOk   = not rsFilterInput or not rsKnown or mansfield > 0
bool upOk   = not slopeFilterInput or slopeState >= 0
bool downOk = not slopeFilterInput or slopeState <= 0

if ready
    int prevStage = stage
    switch stage
        0 =>
            if close > ma and slopeState == 1
                toS2 := true
            else if close < ma and slopeState == -1
                toS4 := true
        1 =>
            if bar_index - stageStart >= baseLen and close > rangeTop and close > ma and upOk and volOk and rsOk
                toS2 := true
            else if close < rangeBot and close < ma and downOk
                toS4 := true
        2 =>
            if close < ma and slopeState <= 0
                toS3 := true
        3 =>
            if close < rangeBot and close < ma and downOk
                toS4 := true
            else if close > rangeTop and close > ma and upOk and volOk and rsOk
                toS2 := true
        4 =>
            if close > ma and slopeState >= 0
                toS1 := true

    int newStage = toS1 ? 1 : toS2 ? 2 : toS3 ? 3 : toS4 ? 4 : stage
    initial := prevStage == 0

    if newStage != stage
        // close the range box of the stage being left
        if not na(rangeBox)
            box.set_right(rangeBox, bar_index)
            rangeBox := na

        // the level the break cleared: resistance for Stage 2, support for Stage 4
        if newStage == 2 or newStage == 4
            breakLevel := newStage == 2 ? rangeTop : rangeBot
            retested   := na(breakLevel)

        stage      := newStage
        stageStart := bar_index

        if newStage == 1 or newStage == 3
            // anchor the range on the extreme that ended the prior trend: the decline low for a base,
            // the advance high for a top, then span everything traded since
            bool  isBase = newStage == 1
            int   first  = math.max(0, bar_index - rangeLen + 1)
            int   anchor = bar_index
            float ext    = isBase ? low : high
            for b = first to bar_index
                float v = isBase ? array.get(lowArr, b) : array.get(highArr, b)
                if (isBase and v < ext) or (not isBase and v > ext)
                    ext    := v
                    anchor := b
            float opp = isBase ? high : low
            for b = anchor to bar_index
                opp := isBase ? math.max(opp, array.get(highArr, b)) : math.min(opp, array.get(lowArr, b))
            rangeTop  := isBase ? opp : ext
            rangeBot  := isBase ? ext : opp
            rangeLeft := anchor
            if showBoxesInput
                color c = stageColor(newStage)
                rangeBox := box.new(rangeLeft, rangeTop, bar_index, rangeBot, border_color = color.new(c, BORDER_TRANSP), bgcolor = color.new(c, BOX_TRANSP), text = newStage == 1 ? 'Stage 1 base' : 'Stage 3 top', text_size = size.small, text_color = c, text_halign = text.align_left, text_valign = newStage == 1 ? text.align_top : text.align_bottom)
        else
            rangeTop := na
            rangeBot := na

        if newStage == 2
            lastBreakVol := volRatio

        if showLabelsInput and (newStage == 2 or newStage == 4 or not showBoxesInput)
            color  c      = stageColor(newStage)
            // trend-stage labels sit beyond the break, over the space price is leaving behind
            bool   below  = newStage == 1 or newStage == 4
            string what   = prevStage == 0 ? 'Stage ' + str.tostring(newStage) : newStage == 2 ? (prevStage == 3 ? 'Stage 2 resumes' : 'Stage 2 breakout') : newStage == 4 ? (prevStage == 1 ? 'Stage 4 resumes' : 'Stage 4 breakdown') : newStage == 1 ? 'Stage 1' : 'Stage 3'
            string volTxt = na(volRatio) or nz(volume) == 0 ? 'n/a' : str.tostring(volRatio, '0.0') + 'x average' + (newStage == 2 ? (volRatio >= volMultInput ? ' (strong)' : ' (light)') : '')
            string tip    = stageName(newStage) + '\nMA slope ' + fmtSigned(slopePct, '#.##') + '% over ' + str.tostring(slopeWeeksInput) + ' weeks\nVolume ' + volTxt + '\nMansfield RS ' + fmtSigned(mansfield, '#.#')
            float  y      = below ? math.min(low, low[1], low[2]) - 0.3 * atrVal : math.max(high, high[1], high[2]) + 0.3 * atrVal
            label.new(bar_index, y, what, style = below ? label.style_label_up : label.style_label_down, color = newStage == 2 or newStage == 4 ? c : HIDDEN_COLOR, textcolor = newStage == 2 or newStage == 4 ? color.white : c, size = size.small, tooltip = tip)
    else if (stage == 2 or stage == 4) and retestInput and not retested and bar_index - stageStart <= retestLen
        float tol = retestTolInput / 100
        if stage == 2 and low <= breakLevel * (1 + tol) and close > breakLevel and close > ma
            retestUp := true
            retested := true
        else if stage == 4 and high >= breakLevel * (1 - tol) and close < breakLevel and close < ma
            retestDown := true
            retested   := true
        if retestUp or retestDown
            color c = stageColor(stage)
            label.new(bar_index, retestUp ? low : high, 'Retest', style = retestUp ? label.style_label_up : label.style_label_down, color = HIDDEN_COLOR, textcolor = c, size = size.small, tooltip = (retestUp ? 'Pullback to the broken resistance ' : 'Rally to the broken support ') + fmtPrice(breakLevel) + (retestUp ? ' held: Weinstein\'s second chance to buy Stage 2' : ' failed: Weinstein\'s second chance to short Stage 4'))
            line.new(stageStart, breakLevel, bar_index, breakLevel, color = color.new(c, 40), style = line.style_dotted)
    else if stage == 1 or stage == 3
        // the range widens until price closes outside it
        rangeTop := math.max(rangeTop, high)
        rangeBot := math.min(rangeBot, low)
        if not na(rangeBox)
            box.set_right(rangeBox, bar_index)
            box.set_top(rangeBox, rangeTop)
            box.set_bottom(rangeBox, rangeBot)

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------}
// Trade Management
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------{

float buf = bufferInput / 100

if ready and tradeInput != 'Off'
    // manage the open position first, on bars after the entry
    if pos == 1 and bar_index > entryBar
        // a correction low becomes the stop only after the advance clears the high that preceded it
        if trailInput and not na(candStop) and close > candRef
            stopLvl  := math.max(stopLvl, candStop * (1 - buf))
            candStop := na
        if trailInput and not na(pivLow) and pivLow * (1 - buf) > stopLvl
            candStop := pivLow
            candRef  := tradeExt
        tradeExt := math.max(tradeExt, high)
        if trailInput and toS3 and not na(rangeBot)
            stopLvl := math.max(stopLvl, rangeBot * (1 - buf))
        if close < stopLvl or toS4
            longExit := true
            exitWhy  := toS4 ? 'Stage 4 breakdown' : 'Stop'
            pos      := 0
    else if pos == -1 and bar_index > entryBar
        // a rally high becomes the stop only after the decline breaks the low that preceded it
        if trailInput and not na(candStop) and close < candRef
            stopLvl  := math.min(stopLvl, candStop * (1 + buf))
            candStop := na
        if trailInput and not na(pivHigh) and pivHigh * (1 + buf) < stopLvl
            candStop := pivHigh
            candRef  := tradeExt
        tradeExt := math.min(tradeExt, low)
        if trailInput and toS1 and not na(rangeTop)
            stopLvl := math.min(stopLvl, rangeTop * (1 + buf))
        if close > stopLvl or toS2
            shortExit := true
            exitWhy   := toS2 ? 'Stage 2 breakout' : 'Stop'
            pos       := 0

    if longExit or shortExit
        float pnl = (longExit ? close / entryPx - 1 : 1 - close / entryPx) * 100
        string txt = (longExit ? 'Exit long ' : 'Cover short ') + fmtSigned(pnl, '#.#') + '%'
        label.new(bar_index, longExit ? high : low, txt, style = longExit ? label.style_label_down : label.style_label_up, color = HIDDEN_COLOR, textcolor = NEUTRAL_COLOR, size = size.small, tooltip = exitWhy + ' at ' + fmtPrice(close) + ' after ' + str.tostring(bar_index - entryBar) + ' bars')

    // new entries on the breakout bars (the first classification is a reading, not a break)
    if toS2 and pos != 1 and not initial
        pos       := 1
        entryPx   := close
        entryBar  := bar_index
        stopLvl   := stopLow * (1 - buf)
        tradeExt  := high
        candStop  := na
        longEntry := true
    else if toS4 and pos != -1 and tradeInput == 'Long & Short' and not initial
        pos        := -1
        entryPx    := close
        entryBar   := bar_index
        stopLvl    := stopHigh * (1 + buf)
        tradeExt   := low
        candStop   := na
        shortEntry := true

//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------}
// Visual Elements
//---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------{

color slopeColor = slopeState == 1 ? s2ColorInput : slopeState == -1 ? s4ColorInput : NEUTRAL_COLOR
color maColor    = maColorInput == 'Stage' ? stageColor(stage) : slopeColor
plot(ma, 'Stage MA', color = maColor, linewidth = 2)

plot(pos == 1 ? stopLvl : na, 'Long Stop', color = s2ColorInput, style = plot.style_steplinebr, linewidth = 1)
plot(pos == -1 ? stopLvl : na, 'Short Stop', color = s4ColorInput, style = plot.style_steplinebr, linewidth = 1)

plot(mansfield, 'Mansfield RS', color = na, display = display.data_window)
plot(stage, 'Stage', color = na, display = display.data_window)

bgcolor(showBgInput and stage > 0 ? color.new(stageColor(stage), bgTranspInput) : na, title = 'Stage Background')

// dashboard
var table dash = na

if showDashInput and barstate.islast
    string pos_ = switch dashPosInput
        'Top Right'   => position.top_right
        'Top Left'    => position.top_left
        'Bottom Left' => position.bottom_left
        => position.bottom_right

    string sz = switch dashSizeInput
        'Tiny'   => size.tiny
        'Normal' => size.normal
        => size.small

    if na(dash)
        dash := table.new(pos_, 2, 8, bgcolor = DASH_BG, border_width = 0, frame_color = DASH_FRAME, frame_width = 1)
        table.merge_cells(dash, 0, 0, 1, 0)

    color  sc       = stageColor(stage)
    float  weeksIn  = na(stageStart) ? na : (bar_index - stageStart) / barsPerWeek
    string slopeTxt = (slopeState == 1 ? 'Rising ' : slopeState == -1 ? 'Falling ' : 'Flat ') + fmtSigned(slopePct, '#.#') + '%'
    float  distPct  = ma > 0 ? (close / ma - 1) * 100 : na
    string warmTxt  = na(ma) ? 'Needs ' + str.tostring(maLen) + ' bars' : stageName(stage)
    string rsTxt    = rsKnown ? fmtSigned(mansfield, '#.#') + (mansfield > nz(mansfield[slopeLen]) ? ' rising' : ' falling') : 'no benchmark data'
    string posTxt   = pos == 1 ? 'Long · stop ' + fmtPrice(stopLvl) : pos == -1 ? 'Short · stop ' + fmtPrice(stopLvl) : 'Flat'

    table.cell(dash, 0, 0, 'Weinstein Stage Analysis', text_color = DASH_TEXT, text_size = sz)
    table.cell(dash, 0, 1, 'Stage', text_color = DASH_HEADER, text_size = sz, text_halign = text.align_left)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 1, warmTxt, text_color = sc, bgcolor = color.new(sc, CELL_TRANSP), text_size = sz)
    table.cell(dash, 0, 2, 'Weeks in stage', text_color = DASH_HEADER, text_size = sz, text_halign = text.align_left)
    table.cell(dash, 1, 2, na(weeksIn) ? '-' : str.tostring(math.floor(weeksIn)), text_color = DASH_TEXT, text_size = sz)

def _build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    """Build the top-level argparse parser with all subcommands."""
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="nse-pipeline",
        description="NSE Data Pipeline: build master → sync history → screen stocks",
        epilog="Use 'menu' command for interactive mode (default).",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--data-dir",
        default=Config.DEFAULT_DATA_DIR,
        dest="data_dir",
        help=f"Root data directory (default: {Config.DEFAULT_DATA_DIR})",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--hist-dir",
        default=Config.DEFAULT_HIST_DIR,
        dest="hist_dir",
        help=f"Historical Parquet directory (default: {Config.DEFAULT_HIST_DIR})",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--dry-run",
        action="store_true",
        help="Simulate operations without making changes",
    )

    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command")

    # build-master
    p_master = sub.add_parser("build-master", help="Build equity master table.")
    p_master.add_argument(
        "--delay", type=float, default=1.0, help="Seconds between index API calls"
    )
    p_master.set_defaults(func=cmd_build_master)

    # sync-history
    p_sync = sub.add_parser("sync-history", help="Sync per-symbol OHLCV Parquet files.")
    p_sync.add_argument("--timeframe", default=Config.DEFAULT_TIMEFRAME)
    p_sync.add_argument("--start-date", default=Config.DEFAULT_START_DATE)
    p_sync.add_argument("--cap-filter", choices=["Large", "Mid", "Small", "Other"])
    p_sync.add_argument("--index-filter")
    p_sync.add_argument("--limit", type=int)
    p_sync.add_argument("--delay", type=float, default=0.5)
    p_sync.add_argument("--source", default="bhavcopy", choices=["bhavcopy", "master"])
    p_sync.set_defaults(func=cmd_sync_history)

    # screen
    p_screen = sub.add_parser("screen", help="Run technical screener.")
    p_screen.add_argument(
        "--processed-dir", default=os.path.join(Config.DEFAULT_DATA_DIR, "processed")
    )
    p_screen.add_argument("--cap-filter", choices=["Large", "Mid", "Small", "Other"])
    p_screen.add_argument("--index-filter")
    p_screen.add_argument("--limit", type=int)
    p_screen.set_defaults(func=cmd_screen)

    # backtest
    p_backtest = sub.add_parser("backtest", help="Run ML backtest.")
    p_backtest.add_argument("--symbol", required=True)
    p_backtest.add_argument("--n-estimators", type=int, default=100)
    p_backtest.add_argument("--max-depth", type=int, default=5)
    p_backtest.set_defaults(func=cmd_backtest)

    # ml-anomaly
    p_anomaly = sub.add_parser(
        "ml-anomaly", help="Run ML anomaly detection for data quality."
    )
    p_anomaly.add_argument("--symbol", required=True)
    p_anomaly.set_defaults(func=cmd_ml_anomaly)

    # fo-ban
    sub.add_parser("fo-ban", help="Fetch F&O ban list.").set_defaults(func=cmd_fo_ban)

    # bhavcopy-sync
    p_bsync = sub.add_parser("bhavcopy-sync", help="Fast incremental OHLCV update.")
    p_bsync.add_argument("--days", type=int, default=10)
    p_bsync.add_argument("--timeframe", default=Config.DEFAULT_TIMEFRAME)
    p_bsync.add_argument("--limit", type=int)
    p_bsync.add_argument("--no-ta", action="store_true", dest="no_ta")
    p_bsync.add_argument("--delay", type=float, default=1.0)
    p_bsync.set_defaults(func=cmd_bhavcopy_sync)

    # fyers-login
    sub.add_parser("fyers-login", help="Get Fyers login URL.").set_defaults(
        func=cmd_fyers_login
    )

    # fyers-token
    p_ft = sub.add_parser("fyers-token", help="Exchange auth code for token.")
    p_ft.add_argument("--code", required=True)
    p_ft.set_defaults(func=cmd_fyers_token)

    # train-ml
    sub.add_parser("train-ml", help="Train ML models interactively.").set_defaults(
        func=cmd_train_ml
    )

    # optimize
    sub.add_parser("optimize", help="Run strategy optimizer interactively.").set_defaults(
        func=cmd_run_optimizer
    )

    # smc-scan
    p_smc_scan = sub.add_parser(
        "smc-scan", help="Run Smart Money Concepts (SMC) scanner across historical data."
    )
    p_smc_scan.add_argument("--limit", type=int, help="Limit number of symbols to scan")
    p_smc_scan.add_argument("--symbol", type=str, help="Scan a single specific symbol (e.g. RELIANCE)")
    p_smc_scan.set_defaults(func=cmd_smc_scan)

    # smc-calls
    p_smc_calls = sub.add_parser(
        "smc-calls", help="View logged SMC trading calls from local SQLite database."
    )
    p_smc_calls.add_argument(
        "--status",
        choices=["PENDING", "ACTIVE", "TRIGGERED", "CANCELLED", "TARGET_HIT", "STOPPED"],
        help="Filter calls by execution status",
    )
    p_smc_calls.set_defaults(func=cmd_smc_calls)

    # menu (default)
    sub.add_parser("menu", help="Launch interactive menu.").set_defaults(
        func=lambda args: interactive_menu(args.data_dir, args.hist_dir)
    )

    return parser


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main entry point
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def main() -> None:
    """Main entry point for the CLI application."""
    parser = _build_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args()

    # Default to menu if no command provided
    if not hasattr(args, "command") or args.command is None:
        interactive_menu(args.data_dir, args.hist_dir)
        return

    # Set dry-run mode if specified
    if hasattr(args, "dry_run") and args.dry_run:
        logger.info("dry_run_mode_enabled")

    # Execute command
    if hasattr(args, "func"):
        try:
            args.func(args)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error("command_failed: command=%s error=%s", args.command, str(e))
            print(f"\n  {red('Error:')} {e!s}\n")
            sys.exit(1)
    else:
        parser.print_help()
        sys.exit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""
Multi-Timeframe Backtest Engine
Extends BacktestInterface with multi-timeframe capabilities
"""

# Ensure src is in sys.path
import os
import sys

if os.path.join(os.getcwd(), "src") not in sys.path:
    sys.path.append(os.path.join(os.getcwd(), "src"))

from typing import Dict, List

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import scipy.stats as stats_sci
from backtesting import Backtest, Strategy

from screeni.data.Fetcher import Fetcher


class MultiTimeframeBacktest:
    """
    Backtest strategies across multiple timeframes
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self.fetcher = Fetcher()

    def run_multi_timeframe_backtest(
        self,
        symbol: str,
        strategy_class: type,
        timeframes: List[str] = ["5m", "15m", "1h", "1d"],
        period: str = "3mo",
        cash: float = 100000,
        commission: float = 0.001,
    ) -> Dict:
        """
        Run backtest across multiple timeframes

        Args:
            symbol: Stock symbol
            strategy_class: Strategy class (must inherit from backtesting.Strategy)
            timeframes: List of timeframes to test
            period: Data period
            cash: Initial cash
            commission: Commission rate

        Returns:
            Dict with results per timeframe
        """
        results = {}

        for tf in timeframes:
            print(f"\n[{tf}] Running backtest for {symbol}...")

            # Fetch data
            data = self.fetcher.fetch_data(symbol, tf, period)

            if data.empty or len(data) < 50:
                print(f"  ⚠️ Insufficient data ({len(data)} rows)")
                results[tf] = None
                continue

            try:
                # Run backtest
                bt = Backtest(data, strategy_class, cash=cash, commission=commission)
                stats = bt.run()

                # Advanced Stats
                adv_stats = self._calculate_advanced_stats(stats)

                results[tf] = {
                    "Return [%]": stats["Return [%]"],
                    "Sharpe Ratio": stats.get("Sharpe Ratio", 0),
                    "Sortino Ratio": stats.get("Sortino Ratio", 0),
                    "Calmar Ratio": stats.get("Calmar Ratio", 0),
                    "Max Drawdown [%]": stats["Max. Drawdown [%]"],
                    "Win Rate [%]": stats.get("Win Rate [%]", 0),
                    "Trades": stats["# Trades"],
                    "Avg Trade [%]": stats.get("Avg. Trade [%]", 0),
                    **adv_stats,
                }

                print(
                    f"  ✅ Return: {stats['Return [%]']:.2f}% | Trades: {stats['# Trades']} | VaR: {adv_stats.get('VaR [95%]', 0):.2f}%"
                )

            except Exception as e:
                print(f"  ❌ Error: {e}")
                results[tf] = None

        return results

    def _calculate_advanced_stats(self, stats) -> Dict:
        """Calculate VaR, p-value, and Information Ratio from backtest stats"""
        adv = {}
        try:
            # Equity curve or returns needed
            equity = stats["_equity_curve"]["Equity"]
            returns = equity.pct_change().dropna()

            # Benchmark (Buy and Hold)
            # Find first and last close to calculate B&H return
            # stats["_strategy"].data is available? No, stats["_strategy"].data leads to the data.
            # But backtesting.py stores the input data in stats["_strategy"].data
            bh_return = (
                stats["_strategy"].data.Close[-1] / stats["_strategy"].data.Close[0] - 1
            ) * 100
            adv["Buy & Hold Return [%]"] = bh_return

            if not returns.empty:
                # Value at Risk (VaR)
                adv["VaR [95%]"] = np.percentile(returns, 5) * 100

                # p-value for strategy significance (T-test vs 0 return)
                t_stat, p_val = stats_sci.ttest_1samp(returns, 0)
                adv["p-value"] = p_val

                # Information Ratio (Relative to Buy & Hold)
                # We need tracking error: std(strategy_returns - benchmark_returns)
                # For daily data, we assume equal steps
                # Simplified: (Ann. Strategy Return - Ann. B&H Return) / Ann. Tracking Error
                stats["Return (Ann.) [%]"] / 100
                # Approximate B&H Annualized if not provided by backtesting.py
                # Let's see if backtesting.py provides Buy & Hold Return [%] in stats
                bh_backtest_val = stats.get("Buy & Hold Return [%]")
                if bh_backtest_val is not None:
                    bh_return = bh_backtest_val

                # Calculate excess returns
                # We approximate excess return on a per-step basis
                # Note: This is a simplified IR without external benchmark data
                adv["Information Ratio"] = (
                    (stats["Return [%]"] - bh_return) / stats["Volatility (Ann.) [%]"]
                    if stats.get("Volatility (Ann.) [%]", 0) > 0
                    else 0
                )

            return adv
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"  ⚠️ Advanced stats error: {e}")
            return {"VaR [95%]": 0, "p-value": 1.0, "Information Ratio": 0}

    def walk_forward_optimization(
        self,
        symbol: str,
        strategy_class: type,
        timeframe: str = "1d",
        train_period: int = 120,  # days
        test_period: int = 30,  # days
        step: int = 30,  # days
        total_period: str = "1y",
    ) -> Dict:
        """
        Walk-forward optimization
        Train on one period, test on next period, roll forward

        Args:
            symbol: Stock symbol
            strategy_class: Strategy class
            timeframe: Timeframe to test
            train_period: Training window (days)
            test_period: Testing window (days)
            step: Step size (days)
            total_period: Total data period

        Returns:
            Dict with walk-forward results
        """
        print(f"\n{'=' * 80}")
        print(f"WALK-FORWARD OPTIMIZATION: {symbol} ({timeframe})")
        print(f"Train: {train_period}d | Test: {test_period}d | Step: {step}d")
        print(f"{'=' * 80}\n")

        # Fetch data
        data = self.fetcher.fetch_data(symbol, timeframe, total_period)

        if data.empty:
            return {"error": "No data available"}

        results = []
        total_bars = len(data)

        # Convert days to bars (approximate)
        if timeframe == "1d":
            train_bars = train_period
            test_bars = test_period
            step_bars = step
        elif timeframe == "1h":
            train_bars = train_period * 6  # ~6 hours per day
            test_bars = test_period * 6
            step_bars = step * 6
        else:
            train_bars = int(train_period * 0.7)  # Rough estimate
            test_bars = int(test_period * 0.7)
            step_bars = int(step * 0.7)

        start_idx = 0

        while start_idx + train_bars + test_bars <= total_bars:
            # Split data
            train_data = data.iloc[start_idx : start_idx + train_bars]
            test_data = data.iloc[
                start_idx + train_bars : start_idx + train_bars + test_bars
            ]

            print(f"Window {len(results) + 1}:")
            print(
                f"  Train: {train_data.index[0].strftime('%Y-%m-%d')} to {train_data.index[-1].strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}"
            )
            print(
                f"  Test:  {test_data.index[0].strftime('%Y-%m-%d')} to {test_data.index[-1].strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}"
            )

            try:
                # Train (optimize on train data)
                bt_train = Backtest(
                    train_data, strategy_class, cash=100000, commission=0.001
                )

                # If strategy has optimizable params, optimize them
                # For demonstration, optimizing common params if they exist
                opt_params = {}
                if hasattr(strategy_class, "sma_period"):
                    opt_params["sma_period"] = range(10, 50, 10)
                if hasattr(strategy_class, "supertrend_period"):
                    opt_params["supertrend_period"] = range(7, 21, 7)

                if opt_params:
                    stats_train = bt_train.optimize(**opt_params, maximize="Return [%]")
                    # Extract best params
                    best_params = {
                        k: getattr(stats_train._strategy, k) for k in opt_params.keys()
                    }
                else:
                    stats_train = bt_train.run()
                    best_params = {}

                # Test (validate on test data using best params from train)
                bt_test = Backtest(
                    test_data, strategy_class, cash=100000, commission=0.001
                )
                stats_test = bt_test.run(**best_params)

                results.append(
                    {
                        "window": len(results) + 1,
                        "train_return": stats_train["Return [%]"],
                        "test_return": stats_test["Return [%]"],
                        "train_trades": stats_train["# Trades"],
                        "test_trades": stats_test["# Trades"],
                        "best_params": best_params,
                    }
                )

                print(f"  Train Return: {stats_train['Return [%]']:.2f}%")
                print(f"  Test Return:  {stats_test['Return [%]']:.2f}%\n")

            except Exception as e:
                print(f"  ❌ Error: {e}\n")

            start_idx += step_bars

        # Summary
        if results:
            avg_test_return = np.mean([r["test_return"] for r in results])
            std_test_return = np.std([r["test_return"] for r in results])

            return {
                "windows": results,
                "avg_test_return": avg_test_return,
                "std_test_return": std_test_return,
                "consistency": (avg_test_return / std_test_return)
                if std_test_return > 0
                else 0,
            }

        return {"error": "No valid windows"}

    def monte_carlo_simulation(
        self,
        symbol: str,
        strategy_class: type,
        timeframe: str = "1d",
        period: str = "1y",
        simulations: int = 100,
        cash: float = 100000,
    ) -> Dict:
        """
        Monte Carlo simulation for risk assessment
        Randomly shuffle trade order to assess strategy robustness

        Args:
            symbol: Stock symbol
            strategy_class: Strategy class
            timeframe: Timeframe
            period: Data period
            simulations: Number of simulations
            cash: Initial cash

        Returns:
            Dict with simulation results
        """
        print(f"\n{'=' * 80}")
        print(f"MONTE CARLO SIMULATION: {symbol} ({timeframe})")
        print(f"Simulations: {simulations}")
        print(f"{'=' * 80}\n")

        # Fetch data
        data = self.fetcher.fetch_data(symbol, timeframe, period)

        if data.empty:
            return {"error": "No data available"}

        # Run base backtest
        bt = Backtest(data, strategy_class, cash=cash, commission=0.001)
        base_stats = bt.run()

        print(f"Base Strategy Return: {base_stats['Return [%]']:.2f}%\n")

        # Run simulations with randomized data
        sim_returns = []

        for i in range(simulations):
            # Shuffle data (maintain OHLC relationships)
            shuffled_data = data.sample(frac=1).reset_index(drop=True)
            shuffled_data.index = data.index  # Keep original dates

            try:
                bt_sim = Backtest(
                    shuffled_data, strategy_class, cash=cash, commission=0.001
                )
                stats_sim = bt_sim.run()
                sim_returns.append(stats_sim["Return [%]"])
            except Exception:
                pass

        if sim_returns:
            return {
                "base_return": base_stats["Return [%]"],
                "sim_mean": np.mean(sim_returns),
                "sim_std": np.std(sim_returns),
                "sim_min": np.min(sim_returns),
                "sim_max": np.max(sim_returns),
                "percentile_5": np.percentile(sim_returns, 5),
                "percentile_95": np.percentile(sim_returns, 95),
                "simulations": len(sim_returns),
            }

        return {"error": "No valid simulations"}


# Example Strategy for Testing
class SimpleMAStrategy(Strategy):
    """Simple Moving Average Crossover Strategy"""

    def init(self):
        close = self.data.Close
        self.sma20 = self.I(lambda x: pd.Series(x).rolling(20).mean(), close)
        self.sma50 = self.I(lambda x: pd.Series(x).rolling(50).mean(), close)

    def next(self):
        if self.sma20[-1] > self.sma50[-1] and self.sma20[-2] <= self.sma50[-2]:
            if not self.position:
                self.buy()
        elif self.sma20[-1] < self.sma50[-1] and self.sma20[-2] >= self.sma50[-2]:
            if self.position:
                self.position.close()

import pandas as pd
import talib


class MomentumIndicators:
    @staticmethod
    def rsi(df: pd.DataFrame, period=14) -> pd.DataFrame:
        """Calculate RSI"""
        df["RSI"] = talib.RSI(df["Close"].to_numpy(dtype=float), timeperiod=period)
        return df

    @staticmethod
    def stochastic(df: pd.DataFrame, fastk=14, slowk=3, slowd=3) -> pd.DataFrame:
        """Calculate Stochastic Oscillator"""
        slowk_series, slowd_series = talib.STOCH(
            df["High"].to_numpy(dtype=float),
            df["Low"].to_numpy(dtype=float),
            df["Close"].to_numpy(dtype=float),
            fastk_period=fastk,
            slowk_period=slowk,
            slowk_matype=0,
            slowd_period=slowd,
            slowd_matype=0,
        )
        df["Stoch_K"] = slowk_series
        df["Stoch_D"] = slowd_series
        return df

    @staticmethod
    def cci(df: pd.DataFrame, period=20) -> pd.DataFrame:
        """Calculate CCI"""
        df["CCI"] = talib.CCI(
            df["High"].to_numpy(dtype=float),
            df["Low"].to_numpy(dtype=float),
            df["Close"].to_numpy(dtype=float),
            timeperiod=period,
        )
        return df

    @staticmethod
    def mfi(df: pd.DataFrame, period=14) -> pd.DataFrame:
        """Calculate Money Flow Index (MFI)"""
        df["MFI"] = talib.MFI(
            df["High"].to_numpy(dtype=float),
            df["Low"].to_numpy(dtype=float),
            df["Close"].to_numpy(dtype=float),
            df["Volume"].to_numpy(dtype=float),
            timeperiod=period,
        )
        return df

    @staticmethod
    def detect_rsi_divergence(df: pd.DataFrame, lookback: int = 20) -> pd.DataFrame:
        """
        Detect RSI divergence vs Price.
        Bullish: Price lower low, RSI higher low
        Bearish: Price higher high, RSI lower high
        """
        try:
            if "RSI" not in df.columns or "Close" not in df.columns:
                df["RSI_Divergence"] = "None"
                return df

            df["Close"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
            df["RSI"].to_numpy(dtype=float)

            df["RSI_Divergence"] = "None"

            if len(df) < lookback:
                return df

            # Check last lookback candles
            recent_data = df.tail(lookback)
            price_recent = recent_data["Close"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
            rsi_recent = recent_data["RSI"].to_numpy(dtype=float)

            price_min_idx = price_recent.argmin()
            price_max_idx = price_recent.argmax()

            # Bullish Divergence: Price makes lower low, RSI makes higher low
            if price_min_idx > lookback // 2:
                prev_price_lows = price_recent[:price_min_idx]
                prev_rsi_lows = rsi_recent[:price_min_idx]

                if len(prev_price_lows) > 0:
                    prev_low_idx = prev_price_lows.argmin()
                    if (
                        price_recent[price_min_idx] < prev_price_lows[prev_low_idx]
                        and rsi_recent[price_min_idx] > prev_rsi_lows[prev_low_idx]
                    ):
                        df.loc[df.index[-1], "RSI_Divergence"] = "Bullish"

            # Bearish Divergence: Price makes higher high, RSI makes lower high
            if price_max_idx > lookback // 2:
                prev_price_highs = price_recent[:price_max_idx]
                prev_rsi_highs = rsi_recent[:price_max_idx]

                if len(prev_price_highs) > 0:
                    prev_high_idx = prev_price_highs.argmax()
                    if (
                        price_recent[price_max_idx] > prev_price_highs[prev_high_idx]
                        and rsi_recent[price_max_idx] < prev_rsi_highs[prev_high_idx]
                    ):
                        df.loc[df.index[-1], "RSI_Divergence"] = "Bearish"

            return df
        except Exception:
            df["RSI_Divergence"] = "None"
            return df

    @staticmethod
    def detect_macd_divergence(df: pd.DataFrame, lookback: int = 20) -> pd.DataFrame:
        """Detect MACD Histogram divergence vs Price."""
        try:
            if "MACD_Hist" not in df.columns or "Close" not in df.columns:
                df["MACD_Divergence"] = "None"
                return df

            df["Close"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
            df["MACD_Hist"].to_numpy(dtype=float)

            df["MACD_Divergence"] = "None"

            if len(df) < lookback:
                return df

            recent_data = df.tail(lookback)
            price_recent = recent_data["Close"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
            macd_recent = recent_data["MACD_Hist"].to_numpy(dtype=float)

            price_min_idx = price_recent.argmin()
            price_max_idx = price_recent.argmax()

            # Bullish Divergence
            if price_min_idx > lookback // 2:
                prev_price_lows = price_recent[:price_min_idx]
                prev_macd_lows = macd_recent[:price_min_idx]

                if len(prev_price_lows) > 0:
                    prev_low_idx = prev_price_lows.argmin()
                    if (
                        price_recent[price_min_idx] < prev_price_lows[prev_low_idx]
                        and macd_recent[price_min_idx] > prev_macd_lows[prev_low_idx]
                    ):
                        df.loc[df.index[-1], "MACD_Divergence"] = "Bullish"

            # Bearish Divergence
            if price_max_idx > lookback // 2:
                prev_price_highs = price_recent[:price_max_idx]
                prev_macd_highs = macd_recent[:price_max_idx]

                if len(prev_price_highs) > 0:
                    prev_high_idx = prev_price_highs.argmax()
                    if (
                        price_recent[price_max_idx] > prev_price_highs[prev_high_idx]
                        and macd_recent[price_max_idx] < prev_macd_highs[prev_high_idx]
                    ):
                        df.loc[df.index[-1], "MACD_Divergence"] = "Bearish"

            return df
        except Exception:
            df["MACD_Divergence"] = "None"
            return df
